• Build and continuously strengthen a future-ready Contract Manufacturing Unit (CMU) network aligned with Orkla Indias strategic growth ambition, category priorities and capacity roadmap.

• Create and maintain a structured CMU library with visibility of partner capabilities, technologies, categories, capacities, certifications, geographic reach, performance and scalability.

• Partner with Business Units to translate the NPD pipeline and demand outlook into make-versus-buy decisions and CMU capacity requirements.

• Assess whether business needs can be met by strengthening existing CMUs or require onboarding new CMUs, ensuring the right balance of capability, capacity, cost, service, scalability & agility.

• Ensure CMUs consistently meet Orkla Indias Quality, Food Safety and EHS standards through robust qualification, audits, compliance monitoring and timely closure of identified gaps.

• Ensuring production & delivery adherence as per agreed service level and help support business growth

• Drive cost competitiveness & commercial effectiveness across the CMU network

• Own end-to-end governance and performance of the CMU ecosystem, from partner identification and due diligence through commercialization, ongoing performance management, capability development and risk mitigation.

**2. Areas of Responsibility (Key Result Areas)**

• CMU strategy and network design: Develop a three-to-five-year CMU roadmap based on business ambition, category strategy, innovation pipeline, demand scenarios and geographic expansion plans.

• CMU library and capability mapping: Build a searchable repository of current and potential CMUs covering product and process capabilities, available capacity, technology, certifications, quality maturity, EHS readiness, cost structure, location, lead times and investment requirements.

• Business partnering and NPD enablement: Establish a regular review with each Business Unit and NPD/R&D team to understand upcoming launches, renovation projects and capacity needs; identify suitable CMUs early enough to support trials, scale-up and launch timelines.

• Existing-versus-new CMU assessment: Evaluate whether to strengthen an existing partner, add technology or capacity, or identify a new partner using clear criteria on strategic fit, technical capability, quality and food safety, EHS, cost, speed, supply resilience and scalability.

• Partner identification and onboarding: Lead market scans, due diligence, site assessments, commercial evaluation, risk assessment, capability trials, contracting and go-live readiness for new CMUs.

• Quality, food safety and EHS governance: In partnership with Quality and EHS, ensure all CMUs meet Orkla India standards, statutory requirements and agreed audit protocols; drive closure of audit observations, CAPA and consumer or market complaints.

• Cost and commercial management: Own processing and P2P cost competitiveness, contract terms, productivity pipelines, should-cost reviews, budgeting and delivery of savings without compromising quality, service or compliance.

• Operations and service delivery: Ensure reliable supply against plan through capacity reviews, material readiness, production planning, inventory controls, dispatch adherence and proactive resolution of constraints.

• Agility and resilience: Develop alternate-source and contingency plans for critical categories and capabilities; improve response time for demand changes, innovation trials and business continuity events.

• Performance management: Establish a CMU scorecard and governance cadence covering service, quality, cost, EHS, compliance, innovation support, responsiveness and improvement actions.

• Capability development: Build long-term partnerships with selected CMUs, driving process maturity, technology upgrades, automation, waste reduction, people capability and continuous improvement.

Team leadership: Build and develop the CMU team, clarify accountabilities, strengthen cross-functional ways of working and create a culture of ownership, compliance and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Factory Manager / Plant Manager (Food Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
***Role:-*** Factory Manager / Plant Manager

(Food Manufacturing)

***Employment Type:-*** Full time, Permanent

***Location:-*** Jigani, Bangalore

***Experience:-***  8 to 12 years in food/FMCG manufacturing, incl. 5+ years leading a plant.

***Direct reports:-*** Production Officer, QC, Stores & Warehouse In-charge, Dispatch team

  

***About US:-***

  

We are a long-established brand with a proven track record of strong, long-standing customer base. We are looking to expand our product portfolio. While deeply rooted in our legacy, our focus remains on innovation and growth.

  

***The Role:-***

  

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Factory Manager to run day-to-day operations at our food plant in Jigani. You will know the shop floor, understand food safety deeply, and build a strong culture of hygiene, safety and continuous improvement.

  

***Responsibilities:-***

  

* **Production:** Plan and run production to meet volume, quality and delivery targets. Track KPIs (OEE, yield, wastage, downtime, cost per unit, OTIF) and act fast on gaps. Make the best use of materials, utilities and manpower, and support new product trials with R&D.
* **Food safety and quality:** Own the plants food safety system and FSSAI compliance, including batch traceability, mock recalls, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* **Safety and compliance:** Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Legal Metrology, Pollution Control Board, fire safety and other laws. Build a zero-harm safety culture, manage effluent and waste, and be the plants contact for inspectors.
* **Maintenance:** Keep equipment and utilities (DG sets, water treatment) reliable through planned maintenance. Plan and manage capex projects on time and budget.
* **People:** Lead and develop supervisors, operators and contract workers. Plan shifts and training, handle grievances fairly, and drive discipline and accountability.
* **Cost, inventory and dispatch:** Manage the plant budget and cost targets. Control stock with FIFO/FEFO to minimise expiry. Plan daily dispatches, manage transporters, and handle paperwork (invoices, e-way bills) and returns.
* **Reporting and improvement:** Share regular MIS reports with management. Lead Lean, 5S, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives, and bring in automation and ERP/digital tools.

  

***Required Qualification:-***

  

* Bachelors degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 8 to 12 years in food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing, with 5+ years as Plant/Factory Manager or equivalent, including hands-on shop-floor experience.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, plus working knowledge of the Factories Act, labour and environmental laws.
* Experience managing a large multi-shift workforce, including contract labour.

  

***Preferred:-***

  

* MBA/Masters in Operations; FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 / BRCGS Lead Auditor or FoSTaC certification; Lean Six Sigma belt.
* Experience with SAP or another ERP, and knowledge of the local regional language.

  

***Key skills:-***

  

* Leadership that motivates teams and leads by example on the shop floor.
* A food safety mindset, treating hygiene and safety as non-negotiable.
* Data-driven problem solving (5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and calm decision-making in breakdowns or recalls.
* Good planning, budgeting and communication with management, regulators, auditors and staff.
* Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi.

  

***How success is measured:-***

  

* Production vs plan and on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery.
* OEE, yield, wastage and cost per unit vs budget.
* Customer complaints, zero recalls and zero lost-time injuries.
* Inventory accuracy, low expiry write-offs, and team attrition and training.

  

***Working conditions:-***

  

* Based at the plant, with shop-floor presence across shifts as needed.
* Must follow hygiene and GMP rules (protective clothing, health checks) and be available for emergencies.

jobs.title: Head of Finance & Accounts
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Head of Finance & Accounts**

**Company:** Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. (Hatti Kaapi)  
**Designation:** Head, Finance & Accounts  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Job Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO

  

**Job Summary**

Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a highly qualified, experienced, and strategic Finance Head to lead the company's Finance & Accounts function.

  

The ideal candidate should have substantial experience in the FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, or Manufacturing industry, with a strong understanding of financial management, business planning, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, and commercial operations.

  

The candidate will be responsible for developing financial strategies, driving profitability, strengthening financial controls, managing working capital, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing strategic financial insights to support business growth.

  

The role requires a hands-on finance leader with the ability to manage multi-location operations, improve financial processes, and work closely with senior management on business decisions.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

  

**1. Financial Planning & Strategic Management**

* Develop and implement financial strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans.
* Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
* Monitor financial performance and provide periodic reports and recommendations to Management.
* Analyse revenue, expenditure, profitability and business performance across outlets and business units.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Evaluate new business opportunities, expansion plans, capital investments and financial feasibility.

  

**2. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports.
* Ensure timely preparation and presentation of Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow statements.
* Develop and implement financial MIS, dashboards and performance tracking systems.
* Monitor outlet-wise, region-wise and business-unit-wise financial performance.
* Analyse budget versus actual performance and highlight deviations with corrective action plans.
* Ensure accuracy, transparency and timely closure of financial records.

  

**3. FMCG / Food & Beverage Commercial Finance**

* Manage financial operations in a multi-location retail, FMCG and food service environment.
* Monitor product costing, food costs, gross margins, contribution margins and operating expenses.
* Implement effective inventory valuation and stock reconciliation processes.
* Monitor raw material procurement costs, wastage, stock movement and inventory holding.
* Work closely with Procurement, Operations and Supply Chain teams to improve cost efficiency.
* Establish effective controls over outlet-level cash collections, expenses, billing and settlements.
* Monitor outlet profitability and identify opportunities for margin improvement.

  

**4. Working Capital & Treasury Management**

* Manage cash flow, fund allocation, liquidity and working capital requirements.
* Monitor accounts receivable, accounts payable, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure timely vendor payments and effective credit management.
* Develop cash flow forecasts and optimise the utilisation of financial resources.
* Maintain banking relationships and coordinate with financial institutions for funding requirements.
* Monitor fund utilisation and ensure adequate liquidity for business operations.

  

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable GST, Income Tax, TDS, TCS, and other statutory requirements.
* Oversee timely filing of statutory returns, payments and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
* Establish strong internal financial controls and ensure proper documentation.
* Monitor changes in taxation laws and regulatory requirements affecting the business.

  

**6. Internal Controls & Risk Management**

* Establish and strengthen internal financial control systems and accounting procedures.
* Develop financial policies, approval matrices, and expense control mechanisms.
* Monitor financial risks, operational leakages and potential irregularities.
* Conduct periodic financial reviews and internal audits across outlets and departments.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of bank accounts, vendor accounts, customer accounts, and inventory.
* Implement corrective measures to minimise financial losses and improve operational efficiency.

  

**7. Accounts & Finance Team Leadership**

* Lead, guide and develop the Finance & Accounts team.
* Define responsibilities, establish performance expectations and monitor team deliverables.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor payments, employee reimbursements, payroll accounting, and financial transactions.
* Build efficient accounting processes and improve departmental productivity.
* Coordinate with HR, Operations, Procurement, Sales and other departments for financial requirements.

  

**8. Audit & Business Coordination**

* Manage statutory, internal, and tax audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, bankers and other external stakeholders.
* Ensure audit schedules, supporting documents and reconciliations are completed on time.
* Present financial performance, business risks and recommendations to senior management.
* Support management in business expansion, investment evaluation and financial decision-making.

  

**Educational Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant / CMA / MBA in Finance from a reputed institution with strong relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of accounting standards, taxation, and financial management.

  

**Experience Requirements**

* 5 - 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounts.
* At least 3 years in a senior finance leadership or managerial position.
* Strong and preferably mandatory experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Manufacturing, or a multi-location business.
* Experience in managing large-scale financial operations, budgeting, costing, taxation, audits, and financial reporting.
* Experience in ERP implementation, accounting automation, and process improvement will be an added advantage.

  

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic financial planning and business partnering.
* Advanced financial analysis and interpretation.
* Strong knowledge of GST, Income Tax, TDS, and statutory compliance.

jobs.title: ODC Manager (Outdoor Catering Manager)
jobs.description:
Hatti Food & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an experienced, results-oriented ODC Manager to manage and execute Outdoor Catering (ODC) operations, corporate events, private functions, exhibitions, and large-scale catering assignments.

  

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end event planning, operational execution, food quality, manpower deployment, vendor coordination, cost control and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience managing outdoor catering operations, leading large teams, coordinating multiple events, and ensuring smooth execution within agreed budgets and timelines.

Key Responsibilities

  

**1. Outdoor Catering & Event Operations**

* Plan, organise and execute outdoor catering assignments, corporate events, weddings, exhibitions, private functions and other catering requirements.
* Manage end-to-end event operations, from initial client discussions and requirement assessment to final execution and closure.
* Coordinate food production, transportation, setup, service and dismantling at event locations.
* Ensure timely delivery and smooth execution of all catering activities.
* Conduct site visits to assess infrastructure, logistics, manpower and operational requirements.

  

**2. Client Management & Business Coordination**

* Coordinate with corporate clients, event organisers, institutions and individual customers to understand their catering requirements.
* Handle client meetings, menu discussions, quotations and event-related coordination.
* Maintain strong client relationships and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Identify new business opportunities and support the development of the ODC business.
* Address client feedback, complaints, and operational concerns professionally.

  

**3. Manpower Planning & Team Management**

* Plan and allocate manpower based on event size and operational requirements.
* Manage supervisors, chefs, kitchen staff, service teams, housekeeping, and temporary event staff.
* Coordinate recruitment and deployment of temporary or outsourced manpower whenever required.
* Ensure proper grooming, hygiene, discipline, and service standards among team members.
* Conduct team briefings and ensure all employees understand their roles and responsibilities.

  

**4. Food Quality & Service Standards**

* Ensure food quality, taste, presentation, and consistency across all catering assignments.
* Coordinate with the kitchen and production teams for menu planning and food preparation.
* Ensure proper food handling, storage, transportation, and temperature control.
* Monitor food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards in compliance with applicable FSSAI requirements.
* Ensure professional service standards and timely food service during events.

  

**5. Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Prepare event-wise budgets and cost estimates based on client requirements.
* Monitor food costs, manpower expenses, transportation, equipment rentals, and other operational expenses.
* Ensure effective utilisation of resources and minimise operational wastage.
* Monitor event profitability and prepare event-wise cost and revenue reports.
* Coordinate with the Finance Department for billing, vendor payments, and expense reconciliation.

  

**6. Vendor & Logistics Management**

* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for raw materials, catering equipment, furniture, transportation, and other event requirements.
* Ensure timely procurement and availability of materials at event locations.
* Manage logistics, transportation, loading, unloading, and movement of catering equipment.
* Maintain proper inventory and ensure the safe handling of company assets.
* Develop and maintain reliable vendor relationships.

  

**7. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain event-wise operational records, budgets, quotations, and expense statements.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly ODC performance reports.
* Track event revenue, expenses, profitability, and customer feedback.
* Submit post-event reports highlighting operational performance, challenges, and improvement areas.
* Ensure proper documentation and coordination with internal departments.

  

**8. General Responsibilities**

* Work closely with the Management, Sales, Kitchen, Procurement, Finance and HR teams.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, food safety regulations, and operational procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve service quality, operational efficiency and business profitability.
* Take ownership of assigned events and ensure successful execution.
* Perform additional responsibilities assigned by Management from time to time.

  

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong experience in Outdoor Catering (ODC) and event operations.
* Excellent event planning and execution skills.
* Strong manpower and team management abilities.
* Knowledge of food production, menu planning, and catering service standards.
* Experience in budgeting, costing, and profitability management.
* Vendor management and negotiation skills.
* Good client relationship and communication skills.
* Strong coordination, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and operational MIS reporting.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple events simultaneously.

  

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Catering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 -10 years of relevant experience in catering, hospitality, or food service operations, preferably with substantial ODC experience.
* Prior experience independently handling large-scale catering events and corporate assignments.
* Experience managing large teams and multiple vendors.
* Willingness to travel and work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, depending on event requirements.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Successful and timely execution of assigned events.
* Event-wise revenue and profitability.
* Food quality and customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Assistant Account Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and analytical **Assistant Manager Accounts** to manage the financial and accounting operations of our rapidly growing FMCG business. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in FMCG accounting, distributor finance, inventory accounting, statutory compliance, taxation, financial reporting, and business finance. This role will be instrumental in ensuring financial accuracy, regulatory compliance, efficient working capital management, and supporting strategic business growth through financial insights.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Operations

* Manage end-to-end accounting functions including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Fixed Assets.
* Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, operational expenses, and payments accurately within defined timelines.
* Perform daily, weekly, monthly, and annual accounting activities including month-end and year-end closing.
* Maintain accurate books of accounts in accordance with accounting standards and company policies.
* Prepare periodic financial statements, schedules, and supporting reconciliations.
* Perform bank reconciliations, cash reconciliations, and inter-company reconciliations on a regular basis.
* Monitor outstanding expenses, provisions, accruals, and prepaid expenses to ensure accurate financial reporting.
* Ensure timely accounting of revenue, expenses, and provisions.

Distributor & Trade Accounting

* Manage accounting and reconciliation of General Trade (GT), Modern Trade (MT), Institutional Sales, and Quick Commerce partners.
* Process and settle distributor claims, promotional schemes, trade discounts, rebates, incentives, sales returns, shortages, and damage claims.
* Monitor distributor receivables and ensure timely collections to minimize overdue balances.
* Manage distributor outstanding balances, ageing reports, and credit control.
* Monitor distributor credit limits and recommend appropriate actions for risk mitigation.
* Coordinate with sales, commercial, and distributor teams for account reconciliation and dispute resolution.
* Ensure timely settlement of distributor accounts and channel partner payments.

Inventory & Cost Management

* Oversee inventory accounting across manufacturing units, warehouses, depots, and distribution centers.
* Ensure accurate stock valuation and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculations.
* Monitor inventory movement, slow-moving inventory, damaged stock, and write-offs.
* Coordinate periodic stock audits and physical verification of inventory.
* Investigate inventory variances and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor logistics, warehousing, transportation, freight, and distribution costs.
* Support cost optimization initiatives across the supply chain.

Working Capital & Financial Control

* Monitor and optimize working capital including receivables, payables, inventory, and cash flow.
* Track debtor ageing, creditor ageing, and inventory holding periods.
* Ensure efficient utilization of funds and improve cash conversion cycle.
* Prepare cash flow forecasts and liquidity reports.
* Monitor return on investment (ROI) for business initiatives, promotional schemes, trade spends, and capital investments.
* Analyze operating expenses and identify opportunities for cost control and process improvement.
* Review outstanding liabilities, advances, and recoverable balances periodically.

Statutory Compliance & Taxation

* Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, TCS, Professional Tax, Income Tax, and other applicable statutory regulations.
* Prepare and review GST returns, TDS returns, tax reconciliations, and statutory filings.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, and government authorities.
* Support statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and compliance reviews.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory payments and filings.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for financial transactions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, Companies Act provisions, and regulatory requirements.

MIS Reporting & Financial Analysis

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly MIS reports covering sales, profitability, expenses, inventory, receivables, payables, and working capital.
* Perform variance analysis against budgets and forecasts.
* Analyze gross margins, contribution margins, ROI, operating costs, and profitability by product, customer, and channel.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for informed decision-making.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, annual operating plans, and financial planning activities.
* Develop dashboards and financial reports for senior management.

Banking & Treasury

* Manage bank reconciliations and monitor daily banking transactions.
* Coordinate with banks regarding payments, collections, banking facilities, and documentation.
* Monitor cash balances and optimize fund utilization.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor payments, statutory payments, salaries, and distributor settlements.
* Support treasury operations and banking compliance.

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

* Strengthen internal financial controls and ensure compliance with company policies.
* Identify opportunities for process automation and operational efficiencies.
* Ensure timely documentation, approvals, and adherence to financial controls.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and Commercial teams.

Qualifications

* B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter / MBA (Finance).
* Additional certifications in Accounting, Taxation, Finance, or ERP systems will be an added advantage.

Experience

* 58 years of accounting and finance experience.
* Minimum 3 years to 4years of latest relevant experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, Consumer Goods, Retail Distribution, Manufacturing, or similar industries.
* Strong experience in distributor accounting, trade promotions, inventory accounting, and financial reporting.
* Experience handling working capital management and business finance is preferred.

jobs.title: IT Assistant / IT Executive
jobs.description:
We are looking for a technically skilled and proactive IT Assistant / IT Executive to manage and maintain the company's IT infrastructure across the Corporate Office, warehouses, and retail outlets.

The candidate will be responsible for providing day-to-day technical support, maintaining computer systems and networks, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, managing IT assets, and ensuring smooth functioning of IT operations across all company locations.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Windows administration, networking, hardware maintenance, troubleshooting, and IT infrastructure support.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. IT Infrastructure & Network Management**

* Install, configure and maintain computer systems, hardware, software and network infrastructure.
* Perform system and network administration, including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and internet connectivity.
* Manage and troubleshoot network devices, routers, switches, data cards, dongles and ISP connectivity.
* Ensure network security and provide remote technical support whenever required.
* Configure and maintain Windows Server environments, including DHCP, DNS, FTP, Group Policies and IIS.

  

**2. Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide day-to-day IT support to employees at the Corporate Office, warehouses and retail outlets.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, operating system, printer, LAN and connectivity-related issues.
* Support and maintain EDC/POS machines, CCTV systems, biometric attendance devices and other IT equipment.
* Install, configure and update antivirus software and ensure systems are protected.
* Handle Windows OS installations, upgrades, migrations and troubleshooting.

  

**3. IT Asset & Equipment Management**

* Maintain an updated inventory of all IT assets, including desktops, laptops, printers, networking devices, CCTV and biometric equipment.
* Track equipment servicing, repairs, replacements and maintenance records.
* Coordinate the movement, installation and allocation of IT equipment between the Corporate Office, warehouse and outlets.
* Maintain proper records of company-issued laptops, desktops and other IT assets.

  

**4. Preventive Maintenance & Data Backup**

* Schedule and carry out periodic preventive maintenance of IT equipment across all company locations.
* Perform regular data backups of company-assigned desktops and laptops.
* Ensure systems are updated and maintained for optimal performance.
* Maintain proper records of system maintenance, backups and IT-related activities.

  

**5. Vendor & Service Provider Coordination**

* Coordinate with IT vendors, suppliers and service providers for hardware purchases, repairs, AMC and maintenance.
* Follow up on service requests, equipment replacements and technical support requirements.
* Assist in evaluating IT products and services based on company requirements.

  

**6. MIS & Documentation**

* Maintain IT-related reports, asset registers, maintenance records and service documentation.
* Prepare and update IT inventory and MIS reports using MS Excel.
* Support the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of IT infrastructure and processes.

  

**7. General Responsibilities**

* Coordinate with internal departments to ensure uninterrupted IT support and smooth business operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT systems, infrastructure and operational efficiency.
* Perform additional IT-related responsibilities as assigned by the reporting manager.

  

**Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of Microsoft Windows Operating Systems and Windows Server environments.
* Hands-on experience in system administration and network troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of DHCP, DNS, FTP, Group Policies and IIS.
* Experience in LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches and internet connectivity.
* Knowledge of antivirus installation, configuration and updates.
* Experience in hardware installation, maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of CCTV, biometric attendance systems and POS/EDC machines.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and MIS reporting.
* Knowledge of data backup, system upgrades and operating system migration.

  

**Candidate Profile**

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Prior experience in IT Support, IT Administration, Desktop Support or Network Administration.
* Practical hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage IT support requirements across multiple locations.
* Willingness to travel to company outlets and other locations whenever required.

  

**Key Competencies**

* Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving.
* Time management and task prioritisation.
* Vendor and stakeholder coordination.
* Asset management and documentation.
* Ownership, accountability and teamwork.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - International Business
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Key Account Manager (KAM), International Business  
**Function:** Account Management, Sales & Business Growth - Pet Food  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (On-Site)  
   
**About Dogsee:**  
At Dogsee, we are passionately crafting a global revolution in the pet industry. Our mission is to elevate canine wellness through a commitment to quality, ethics, and innovation. With a foundation of love for dogs, we create 100% human-grade treats that nourish pets' health and happiness.  
   
Through strategic partnerships, innovative Go-To-Market strategies, and a dedicated team, Dogsee has achieved a robust presence in 30+ countries. We are continuously redefining global pet care standards, earning international recognition for Indian pet brands. Guided by our mission, we aim to foster cultural resonance, prioritize pet health, and inspire positive industry change.  
   
**Role Summary:**  
We are seeking a highly motivated and dynamic **Key Account Manager (KAM)** to lead the charge in driving sales growth, expanding business, and delivering exceptional client experiences across international markets. This individual will take full ownership of assigned international clients, ensuring client retention, exceeding sales targets, and exploring new growth opportunities.  
   
As the primary point of contact for key accounts, the KAM will focus on nurturing long-term client relationships while leveraging insights to maximize account revenue. The role demands tight alignment with sales targets and KPIs, coupled with proactive efforts to expand Dogsee's presence in global markets.  
   
In addition to managing existing accounts, the KAM will identify and onboard new distributors, resellers, and buyers across diverse geographies, helping Dogsee achieve its ambitious international growth objectives. This role also entails active collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations, timely delivery, and outstanding client satisfaction.  
   
**Key Responsibilities:**  
   
**Sales Growth & Expansion:**

* Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue and growth targets.
* Actively identify new business opportunities and onboard distributors, resellers, and retail buyers in international markets.
* Expand Dogsee's client base by identifying untapped markets and regions with high growth potential.

**Account Management & Client Relations:**

* Build, nurture, and sustain strong relationships with international clients to drive loyalty and repeat business.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned key accounts, addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.
* Conduct regular business reviews with clients to discuss performance, sales trends, and areas for mutual growth.

**Strategic Business Planning:**

* Collaborate with clients on Joint Business Planning (JBP) initiatives to create mutually beneficial growth strategies.
* Leverage market insights and sales data to identify new opportunities and refine account strategies.

**Target Alignment & Reporting:**

* Tightly monitor and align activities with assigned sales and revenue targets.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and generate actionable reports to assess account performance and profitability.

**Operations Coordination:**

* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including logistics, supply chain, and finance, to ensure seamless execution of shipments and order fulfillment.
* Oversee the preparation of shipping documentation, ensuring adherence to international trade regulations and Incoterms.

**Market Intelligence:**

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
jobs.description:
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.
  
  
Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
* Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
* Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
* Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
* Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.
  
  
Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.
  
  
**About The Team**
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.
  
  
This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience within financial services and payment institutions
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
* Master's degree or equivalent

jobs.title: Loan Servicing Representative
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**  

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Loan Servicing Representative** to support critical loan servicing operations within our organization. In this role, you will help deliver accurate, timely, and customer-focused servicing solutions while ensuring adherence to established operational controls and risk management practices.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Support day-to-day Loan Servicing processes by completing moderately complex administrative, transactional, operational, and customer service activities.
* Review, research, calculate, prepare, and submit moderately complex mortgage claims accurately and within established timelines.
* Research and respond to written and telephone inquiries from customers, title companies, vendors, and internal partners regarding loans and Loan Servicing processes.
* Apply relevant information and established guidelines to make sound decisions when reviewing and filing claims.
* Ensure work complies with applicable federal and state requirements and with client and company policies, procedures, and controls.
* Identify process or service improvement opportunities within Loan Servicing and recommend practical solutions.
* Receive direction from Loan Servicing supervisors and escalate non-routine or complex matters to more experienced team members.

  
  
**Required Qualifications**  

* 1+ year of Loan Servicing support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Experience in mortgage servicing processes, loan documentation, and servicing transactions

  
  
**Desired Qualifications**  

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Security
jobs.description:
Job Function: Corporate Security Geographic Coverage: India (Noida, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Cochin, Vizag) Employment Type: Full-Time Industry: IT / ITES

Role Summary

The Senior Manager - Corporate Security is responsible for leading and managing security operations across multiple delivery centers in India - This is an execution-focused and operational role, accountable for ensuring a safe, compliant, and risk-resilient environment, with strong emphasis on incident management, vendor goverce, regulatory compliance, and business continuity in a highly regulated IT/ITES environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end security operations across all assigned locations (Noida, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Vizag, Cochin)
* Ensure consistent deployment adherence of security policies, SOPs, operational controls across all sites along with driving standardization goverce of security practices across the portolio.
* Maintain a safe and secure working environment across facilities
* Lead investigation, response, and closure of security incidents, breaches, and violations
* Conduct root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive action measures.
* Drive and implements proactive risk mitigation and loss prevention initiatives and strategies across the portiolio
* Manage and govern security vendors (guarding, SOC, electronic surveillance partners) across locations
* Monitor and Drive vendor performance through SLA/KPI adherence, audits, and reviews
* Lead vendor transitions if they occur - drive operational stabilization, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Oversee operations of CCTV, Access Control, Fire Detection and Fire Fighting Life Safety, and SOC / BMS systems. Ensure up time, compliance, and periodic audits of all security infrastructure. Drive access goverce, monitoring, and periodic reviews
* Compliance, Audits Regulatory Goverce and Alignment: Ensure adherence and compliance to internal security standards and external regulatory requirements. Support audits (ISO, client audits, internal audits) along with maintaining security documentation, policies, and audit trails. Ensure compliance with statutory requirements and global security frameworks, including: ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, HITRUST CSF, OHS. Act as liaison with law enforcement, regulatory bodies, and audit agencies. Lead and support client, internal, and external audits, ensuring timely closure of observations and findings. Ensure control effectiveness, documentation, and audit readiness across all sites
* Emergency Response, Crisis Response and Business Continuity: Drive and support Emergency Response Team (ERT) readiness and execution of drills. Maintain and periodically update Emergency Action Plans and BCP frameworks for all sites. Coordinate with business, facilities, and leadership during disruptions. Support crisis management and incident escalation protocols, including war-room activation and participation where required
* Stakeholder Management: Partner with Real Estate Facilities, HR, Compliance, Transport, IT, and Business Leaders. Provide regular updates on security posture, incidents, and risk mitigation plans. Provide regular MIS, dashboards, and risk updates. Act as the central SPOC for all corporate security matters across locations. Conduct employee awareness sessions, onboarding briefings, and periodic security trainings
* Goverce, Reporting Continuous Improvement: Drive periodic security reviews, audits, and compliance assessments. Develop standardized MIS reporting, dashboards, and leadership updates. Identify opportunities for cost optimization, process improvement, and risk reduction

* Strong operational leadership in multi-site environments

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**📌 About Us**

Posha is building robot kitchens for the future.

Our first product, the Posha Countertop was recognized as one of
**TIME’s Best Inventions of 2025**
and received rave reviews from
**The Verge**
and
**WIRED**
for bringing robotics and AI into everyday kitchens.

We’re a fast-growing
**Series A–funded**
startup backed by
**Accel Partners**
and we’re just getting started.

See it in action:
https://youtu.be/Ubd6NkZOEkM?si=SFex-isehKHzvZs\_

**🤔 What can I expect from this role?**

Posha is one of the rare robotics startups building
**production-grade consumer robots**
, with
**hundreds of units deployed in real homes**
.

You own the electrical design of robotics cooking system that packs power electronics(induction heating), analogs (sensors, actuators) and high-speed design (cameras, display and a GPU) into one consumer robotic system.

**🔧 What will my work responsibilities look like if I join Posha?**

* Design the induction heating power stage, from mains input to inverter and coil, and keep its noise away from the sensitive electronics next to it.
* Design the analog and digital circuits that read the product's sensors and drive its motors and actuators.
* Own the high-speed design for the camera, display and GPU, getting signal and power integrity right next to a switching power stage.
* Review every schematic before it goes to layout, whether it was drawn in-house or by a vendor.
* Take boards from bring-up through safety and EMC certification into production with our contract manufacturers.

**😍 What makes you a match for us?**

* You have a B.E./B.Tech in Electrical or Electronics Engineering and 5+ years designing board-level electronics for a product that shipped.
* You decided what the circuit should be and owned the schematic yourself; drawing the layout from someone else's design doesn't count.

**🚀 What The World Thinks of Posha**

* Posha is comparable to Tesla FSD
* “
  *Posha is a fairly good sign that the future is closer than I thought*

  ” - The Verge
* *Posha’s tagline is “See dinner cook itself, and it largely lives up to this.”*

  - WIRED

**Why Posha?**

* Few organizations offer challenges similar to ours. Building completely autonomous cooking robots requires thinking from first principles and building from ground up.
* We believe that Posha is a generational company with the opportunity to alter the trajectory of how food is cooked inside homes today. This opportunity is parallel to how autonomous cars have made an impact.
* This role will be at the forefront of this opportunity.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of more than 90 software companies worldwide, Vista supports growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is helping its portfolio companies apply generative AI responsibly across products, operations, and decision-making. Vista also supports learning and development through portfolio-wide programs, leadership workshops, and AI initiatives.

About Amtech

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vistas investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Execution

* Own or support the product backlog for automated scheduling applications and related labeling or corrugated ERP capabilities.
* Work with Product Managers and in-market product leadership to translate roadmap initiatives into epics, user stories, and actionable backlog items.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on customer needs, product direction, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and ensure items are ready for sprint planning.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan delivery across multiple sprints and longer-term initiatives.
* Maintain product artifacts and, at the Senior Product Owner level, review PDLC artifacts for completeness and quality.

Manufacturing and Customer Insight

* Engage with customers, customer support, implementation, and services teams to understand manufacturing workflows and scheduling challenges.
* Translate production scheduling and manufacturing requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Help resolve software defects and define customer-specific features in collaboration with product management.
* Ensure product decisions reflect customer needs and support broader product goals.

Agile Delivery and Coordination

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in or facilitate sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.
* Clarify requirements and help teams understand the intended product outcomes.
* At the Senior Product Owner level, coordinate and support product owners across the India-based labeling and corrugated teams, and help build shared practices through a community of practice.

Product Delivery and Continuous Improvement

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Provide product expertise to internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities and product-owner practices.

Skills and Qualifications

* **Product Owner II:** Typically 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar software product role.
* **Senior Product Owner:** Typically 7+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including experience coordinating or supporting other Product Owners.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining requirements.
* Experience with ERP systems and the ability to translate business needs into technical product specifications.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with distributed teams.
* For the Senior Product Owner focus, experience facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning, and establishing or maintaining standards for product artifacts.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with manufacturing, production scheduling, scheduling optimization, or ERP applications.
* Knowledge of production operations, shop-floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.
* Experience with ERP integrations and manufacturing workflows.
* Experience working with in-market product leadership in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Experience coaching or supporting other Product Owners or building a community of practice.
* Familiarity with Jira or similar backlog-management tools.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you’ll help deliver software that supports real manufacturing operations while benefiting from Vista’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented teams, access cross-portfolio learning opportunities, and contribute to the continued development of Amtech’s ERP and scheduling products.

***Note:** Tarlan is hiring a Senior Product Manager, Logistics and Supply Chain, for a global logistics technology company.*

  

**About the Company**

The company provides an agentic Transportation Management System for enterprises for all-mile and all-channel, trusted by global enterprises.

  

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

  

**The Companys Journey and Impact**

The company has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Its platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30+ countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance.

  

**Global Footprint**

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, the company brings together 170+ engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

  

**Traits the Company Values**

The company looks for people who are:

* Global in mindset: curious about diverse markets and ideas.
* Unrelenting in drive: energized by complex challenges.
* Intelligent in approach: analytical, creative, and thoughtful.
* Dynamic in execution: adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.
* Exact in craft: detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

  

**Why this role**

This is an execution-heavy role working directly with the companys Director of Product. You will not be tied to one product: you take on execution for whichever products he owns, today and as they change. That means cross-product work and a seat in customer conversations.

  

**What you will do**

* Help build and run the roadmap: plan the quarter, size and sequence the work, and check the team is ready to deliver it (scope, dependencies, people) before committing.
* Take a problem from first ask to shipped: spec, acceptance criteria, grooming, release, adoption.
* Work daily with engineering, design and solutions to unblock and ship.
* Turn customer and field feedback into small, clear tickets, and say no to the rest.
* Join customer workshops and requirement calls; write and chase the follow-ups.
* Own cross-product items no one else owns, including the unglamorous parts.

  

**You have**

* 6 to 10 years in product, with real time in logistics or supply chain (TMS, last mile, carrier or fleet management, warehouse or network planning).
* Shipped B2B SaaS features, and can show the spec, the ticket and the outcome.
* Comfort with data (SQL or sheets) and APIs (you can read a payload).
* Clear, short writing. Daily use of AI tools.

  

**Who you are**

* High agency. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap, own it and close it.
* You get stuff done. You finish what you start and chase it until it ships.
* Ambitious and hungry to prove yourself; you want more ownership, fast.
* Ready to get your hands dirty: test the build, fix the data, sit with ops.
* Happy to work hard, especially around go-lives.

  

**What the Company Offers**

Join the company and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. The company provides competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

  

The company is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

jobs.title: Sr Process Engineer (CBG)
jobs.description:
**Engineering & Process Manager – CBG**

**Company Industry - Biogas**

**Position Overview**

The
**Engineering & Process Manager – CBG**
will be responsible for leading process engineering, technology development, plant design, technical proposals, and engineering coordination for
**Compressed Biogas (CBG) and biogas projects**
. The role requires strong knowledge of anaerobic digestion, feedstock evaluation, process design, equipment selection, and coordination across engineering, commercial, execution, and customer teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Process Engineering**

· Develop process concepts and process design for CBG/biogas plants.

· Evaluate feedstock characteristics, including agricultural residues, press mud, food waste, fruit waste, Napier grass, cattle dung, and other organic substrates.

· Carry out feedstock assessment, biogas yield calculations, organic loading, hydraulic retention time, digester sizing, and mass/energy balances.

· Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, process calculations, equipment specifications, and process datasheets.

· Optimize digester configuration, mixing systems, feeding systems, gas handling, and downstream processes.

· Provide technical inputs for plant performance guarantees and commissioning requirements.

**2. Engineering Management**

· Lead multidisciplinary engineering activities covering process, mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation, and civil interfaces.

· Review engineering drawings, layouts, equipment specifications, and vendor documents.

· Coordinate with internal engineering teams, consultants, vendors, EPC partners, and customers.

· Ensure engineering deliverables are completed within project timelines and agreed technical requirements.

**3. Technical & Commercial Proposals**

· Lead preparation of technical proposals for CBG projects.

· Define technical scope, battery limits, equipment requirements, exclusions, and assumptions.

· Work closely with the commercial team to develop accurate project costing and commercial offers.

· Review customer RFQs, tender documents, specifications, and technical requirements.

· Participate in technical discussions and negotiations with customers and EPC partners.

**4. Project & Execution Support**

· Provide engineering support during procurement, fabrication, construction, installation, commissioning, and operation.

· Resolve technical issues arising during project execution.

· Review site requirements and support project teams with engineering decisions.

· Participate in commissioning and performance evaluation of CBG plants.

· Analyze plant operating data and recommend process improvements where required.

**5. Technology & Process Development**

· Continuously evaluate improvements in anaerobic digestion and CBG technologies.

· Develop standardized engineering practices, design parameters, calculation methods, and technical documentation.

· Maintain project learnings and incorporate operational experience into future plant designs.

· Support development of solutions for multi-feedstock CBG plants.

**Required Qualifications**

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in
**Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline**
.

· Typically
**8–15 years of relevant experience**
in biogas, CBG, anaerobic digestion, waste-to-energy, process engineering, or related industries.

· Strong practical understanding of anaerobic digestion and CBG plant design.

· Experience with engineering documentation such as PFDs, P&IDs, equipment datasheets, layouts, and process calculations.

· Experience in handling customers, EPC contractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Overall, the Research Scientist will serve an essential function to bridge internal process development teams with both internal and external manufacturing teams, ensuring successful completion of engineering, CT, PPQ/Registration, and early commercial drug substance batches.
  
  
**Functions, Duties, Tasks:**

* Oversee all aspects of process transfer activities for biotechnology products to internal and/or external CDMOs
* Manage all associated relationships with sending and receiving site SMEs, project leaders, and tech transfer leads.
* Author, review, and edit technical documents, protocols, and reports, ensuring compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) or other applicable regulatory/quality requirements.
* Communicate regularly to project and technical teams, as well as senior management regarding project progress, risks, gaps, and mitigation strategies.
* Travel to both sending site and receiving site as needed to ensure successful process transfer and facilitate timely communication

**Minimum Qualification (education, experience and/or training, required certifications):**
**Education/Experience:**
Ph.D. in biology, biochemistry, biotechnology or a related field with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry
  
  

* OR-

M.S. in the above listed fields with a minimum of 10 years of experience
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

* Demonstrated experience with either upstream or downstream process development for mammalian cell culture derived biotechnology products
* Experience managing technical activities with external CDMOs or CDMO experience managing client projects
* Execution or oversight of work in a regulated environment
* Excellent communication and organizational skills; attention to detail
* Demonstrated experience with authoring and editing technical documents

**Additional Preferences:**

* Experience in both upstream and downstream process development with CHO-cell bioprocess for mAbs and/or protein therapeutics
* Thorough understanding of GMP requirements, quality systems, and associated regulatory structures.
* Experience with technical and process transfer of mammalian bioprocess from development to manufacturing, preferably to 3rd Party CDMOs
* Experience with statistical approaches to experimental design (DoE) and the ability to analyze, interpret, and document complex data.

jobs.title: Asset Earth Scientist (Shale &Tight)
jobs.description:
Total Number of Openings 1

Uses advanced digital workflows and application skills to support geoscience workscope. Generates maps and other analysis for internal use, regulatory submissions, conducts QC and data management. Has high degree of familiarity with a variety of geoscience data (seismic and well data), data loading, naming conventions, data formats, data manipulation and analysis. Supports clients/customers and assists with functional projects under regular supervision. Has a general knowledge of the work function.

The Asset Geologist supports development planning, reservoir characterization, subsurface uncertainty reduction, and value optimization for shale and tight assets. This role develops integrated geologic interpretations and decision-support products by combining geological, geophysical, petrophysical, engineering, production, and external benchmark data. The successful candidate will work closely with global asset teams and technical specialists to support field development decisions, improve well performance, identify development opportunities, and improve understanding of subsurface risk and uncertainty. The role is expected to influence development decisions and business outcomes through direct collaboration with global asset teams and technical specialists. This role provides opportunities to apply digital technologies, analytics, and workflow improvements that accelerate technical decision making and business value delivery.

### Responsibilities

* Develop integrated geologic frameworks, reservoir characterization studies, maps, and interpretation products that support field development planning and reservoir management.
* Integrate geological, geophysical, petrophysical, production, completion, and engineering datasets to improve understanding of reservoir performance and development opportunities.
* Support well planning activities, including landing target recommendations, spacing evaluations, development sequencing, and risk mitigation.
* Conduct uncertainty assessments and recommend surveillance, appraisal, and data acquisition programs that improve decision quality.
* Evaluate well performance trends and integrate geologic learnings into development recommendations and forecasting workflows.
* Perform competitor benchmarking and external analog evaluations to identify value-creation opportunities and improve development planning assumptions.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers, production engineers, geophysicists, petrophysicists, drilling and completions teams, commercial teams, and operations partners.
* Deliver technical recommendations that clearly communicate assumptions, risks, opportunities, and business impacts.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of subsurface workflows through digital tools, analytics, automation, and standardization efforts.
* Share technical knowledge and support capability building across the Earth Science community.

### About you

We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.

To be considered for this role, applicants should have:

### Required Qualifications

* Masters degree or higher in geology, geophysics, geological engineering, or a related earth science discipline.
* 5-15 years of experience in reservoir characterization, development geology, integrated interpretation, or field development planning.
* Experience integrating seismic, well logs, petrophysical data, production information, and engineering data into development recommendations.
* Working knowledge of subsurface interpretation and modeling platforms such as Petrel or similar software.
* Strong technical foundation in stratigraphy, sedimentology, structural geology, basin analysis, reservoir quality evaluation, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to frame uncertainty, evaluate risks, and influence technical decisions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting shale and tight developments.
* Advanced experience with subsurface interpretation and modeling workflows.
* Experience with competitor benchmarking and development optimization studies.
* Familiarity with data visualization, automation, analytics, scripting, or digital workflow development.
* Experience supporting integrated asset development planning and business decision making.
* Experience working with global asset teams, technical centers, or distributed delivery teams.

### Selection Criteria

* Demonstrated technical depth in reservoir characterization, geologic framework mapping, integrated interpretation, and development geology.
* Ability to connect geologic interpretation to production performance, development planning, risk mitigation, and economic outcomes.
* Strong judgment in uncertainty framing, data acquisition recommendations, and risk-based decision support.
* Ability to influence cross-functional development decisions through clear technical logic and practical recommendations.
* Strong collaboration across geology, geophysics, petrophysics, reservoir engineering, production engineering, drilling and completions, operations, and commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, and ability to deliver high-quality subsurface products under business timelines.

jobs.title: Intern-Livelihoods Scaling-SELCO Foundation
jobs.description:
SELCO Foundation is a not-for-profit organization engaged in field-based research and development (R&D) and ecosystem building to promote decentralized renewable energy solutions that alleviate poverty across urban, rural, and tribal communities. The Foundation works across multiple sectors including energy access, the built environment, healthcare, skill development, entrepreneurship, and sustainable livelihoods. Our mission is to design and implement socially, financially, and environmentally inclusive solutions through access to sustainable energy.
  
  
Within the Agriculture and Allied Livelihoods vertical, SELCO Foundation develops sustainable energy-driven solutions across agriculture, animal husbandry, and allied sectors. We work with diverse value chains including cereals, millets, oilseeds, spices, dairy, poultry, horticulture, and post-harvest systems to improve productivity, diversify farm incomes, reduce drudgery, and strengthen climate resilience. Our work focuses on enabling smallholder farmers, FPOs/FPCs, SHGs, entrepreneurs, and ecosystem stakeholders through innovative technologies, research, and capacity building.
  
  
The Livelihood scaling Intern will contribute to research, documentation, scaling solutions, stakeholder engagement, and knowledge management to support the scaling and amplify solution of sustainable agriculture.
  
  
You can find more information about SELCO Foundation and our work on our Organization Website.

PlayShifu is one of the fastest-growing technology startups creating AR-powered educational toys that make learning fun and interactive. Our award-winning products are sold across 35+ countries, and we're continuing to expand our global footprint.

We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to lead our sourcing, procurement, and international logistics functions. This role will be instrumental in building a resilient supplier network, driving cost efficiencies, managing global freight flows, and ensuring seamless product availability across markets. If you thrive in a fast-paced consumer products environment and enjoy solving complex supply chain challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

**What You'll Do:**

**Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management**

* Own end-to-end sourcing strategy for product components, packaging materials, and finished goods across domestic and international suppliers.

**Who we are :**

Money. A subject that’s always on our mind. We go through a rollercoaster of emotions when it comes to money. That’s why at Jupiter, our mission is to enable people to improve their relationship with money.

We are a financial services platform that leverages technology to offer our customers seamless and user-friendly products related to banking, loans, and investments. So whether it’s a savings account, credit cards, investment and payments, it's all on Jupiter. We also help users cut through the banking jargons, offer smart insights based on spending and provide users with a range of new age features to enable and make sense of their finances.

  

**Our journey so far:**

Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea : to create a modern, customer-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.

  

From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2.7 million + happy users on Jupiter.

  

Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.

  

We've embraced cutting-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like-minded folks to join the crew.

jobs.title: Production Manager
jobs.description:
**Position** **: Production Manager**

**Reporting to** **: Director**

**Key Responsibilities includes & not limited to:**

· Responsible for planning, managing and executing production operations.

· Responsible for recording and filing of all relevant record logs and documentation.

· Develop production plan and timelines according to production specifications.

· Determine production requirements based on plant capacity and production specifications.

· Plan work flow and schedules for production departments.

· Monitor production status and ensure timely delivery.

· Identify delays and accordingly adjust schedules to meet deadlines.

· Provide excellent customer service and ensure customer satisfaction.

· Ensures that finished products meet quality standards and customer specifications.

· Determine equipment, materials and manpower required to complete production.

· Resolve production issues and escalate unresolved issues to management promptly.

· Plan and prioritize operations to ensure maximum performance and minimum delay.

· Determine manpower, equipment and raw materials needed to cover production demand.

· Address issues when they arise aiming for minimum disruption.

· Obtain output information (number of finished products, percentage of defectives etc.)

· Collaborate with quality control, warehouse and other staff

* Develop and implement daily, weekly, and monthly production plans.
* Ensure timely manufacturing of coffee products as per demand forecast.
* Monitor raw material availability and consumption.

· Ensure adherence to quality standards (FSSAI, ISO, HACCP, etc.).

* Work closely with QA/QC teams to maintain product consistency.
* Implement corrective actions for deviations and non-conformities.

· Optimize roasting, grinding, blending, and packaging processes.

* Identify areas for process improvement and cost reduction.
* Minimize waste and increase machine utilization.

· Coordinate with maintenance for preventive and breakdown maintenance.

· Ensure minimal downtime of production equipment.

· Maintain daily production reports, batch records, and shift logs.

· Track KPIs like OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), yield, wastage, etc.

· Present reports to senior management.

· Coordinate with marketing & Sales team for the production &Dispatch planning as per Customer requirement.

· Co ordinate with QC team in new product development and commercial trials.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
