jobs.description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."

* Locations

  + Bangalore, India
* Employment Types

  + Permanent co-worker
* Department

  Food & Restaurant
* Full/Part Times

  + Full Time
* Mobility support

  Domestic

  

Candidate profile (title) What you need to know

Candidate profile (text) - Default language As a person you are passionate about people, business, IKEA’s purpose and continuously driving better performance. You are energized by increasing customer value, driving business growth and contributing to overall success and results through people as well as motivated by leading and developing people. For this role we believe you have:

* Capability to lead the business and deliver results through involving and engaging various stakeholders utilizing Situational leadership.
* Capability to build trust and relationships that evolve into long-term business partnership.
* Capability to perform complex negotiations and achieve results through jointly decided actions with stakeholders and business partners
* Ability to navigate in operational, complex environment as well as seeing the total long-term holistic view.
* Understand and follow the IKEA group Code of conduct and IKEA business ethics.
* Understand and work in line with the IKEA strategic landscape.
* Understand the IKEA business model and IKEA Supply Chain to meet end customer expectation.
* Understand the Category Business plan and be able to transfer the knowledge into Purchasing Development Process (PDP), Supplier/Service Provider Development process (SDP), Business contingency planning (BCP).
* Understand and follow the IKEA purchasing manual and relevant procedures and manuals

Key responsibilities (title) Your responsibilities

Key responsibilities (text) Drive business partner base (open, develop, close business partners) according to the Category Business plan and Purchasing Manual (and respective procedures and manuals).

* Lead the business performance in the business team together with all members of the team.
* Together with the business partners, continuously strive for lowest possible cost to contribute to the total lower cost for IKEA products.
* Responsibility to build professional and long-term relationship with business partners as well as internal stakeholders through IKEA way of doing business.
* Lead Supplier/Service Provider Development Process (SDP/SPDP) to contribute to action plan (APL).
* Responsibility to follow up and deliver agreed goals agreed in the action plans.

* Continuously motivate and professionally challenge business partners to take ownership for their own performance as agreed in business partners action plans.
* Actively contribute to new product development process as well as product life cycle management (in Purchasing Development).
* Pro-actively identify and implement new business opportunities.
* Be an ambassador of IKEA values and culture in everyday work.

Team vision ( title) Together as a team

Team vision (text) Thanks to us, customers, co-workers and people at home can have a better everyday life through food that’s good for both people and planet. Together we serve more than 660 million customers yearly at the IKEA restaurants worldwide, underlining our Scandinavian heritage by offering a modern taste of Sweden. We also offer a variety of foods in our bistros and in the “Swedish Food market”. We are a diverse group of people who all live by the motto: Laughter is brightest in the place where the food is!
  
Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

**Job Details:**

We are looking for a hands-on **Platform Engineer** with strong foundations in data and analytics engineering to help build scalable, reusable, and intelligent capabilities for modern enterprise data platforms.

This role sits within the **Data Platforms organization** and is ideal for an engineer with strong proficiency in **SQL, Python, dbt, data modeling, data transformation, and analytics engineering** who wants to grow into broader platform engineering.

  

The engineer will apply data and analytics development skills toward **building platform products** including reusable data frameworks, standardized transformation patterns, data quality and reliability capabilities, automation, observability, APIs, and self-service solutions. The role provides an opportunity to expand into Cloud, DevOps, Software engineering, and AI while maintaining a strong data engineering foundation.

  

At Tyson Foods, you will have the opportunity to solve enterprise-scale data challenges while working with modern data, cloud, automation, and AI technologies in a culture that values problem solving, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and ownership.

  

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

  

* Design and build scalable **data pipelines, models, and transformation components to enable monitoring, observability, automation, reliability, and optimization across data platforms** , using SQL, Python, dbt, and modern data technologies.
* Develop robust data models using **dimensional modeling principles, including Kimball methodologies, fact/dimension design, and reusable analytical structures** .
* Translate data and analytics engineering solutions into **reusable platform capabilities** , frameworks, APIs, automation, and self-service services that can be adopted across engineering teams.
* Build standardized capabilities for **data quality, reconciliation, freshness, reliability, orchestration, monitoring, and observability** .
* Work & Collaborate across the enterprise data platform technology ecosystem, spanning **data ingestion (Fivetran, HVR/Kafka), transformation and orchestration (dbt, Airflow, Spark), cloud data processing (BigQuery), and visualization (Power BI)** , to engineer scalable, cloud-native data platform solutions.
* Apply modern software engineering practices including **Git, automated testing, CI/CD, modular development, code reviews, and documentation** .
* Analyze complex data and platform issues, perform root-cause analysis, and improve **performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency** .
* Collaborate across data engineering, analytics, architecture, platform, product, and governance teams to design scalable solutions.
* Explore and apply **AI/Generative AI** to analytics, data engineering, development, testing, troubleshooting, automation, and emerging platform capabilities.
* Continuously learn, explore, and adopt new data, cloud, DevOps, AI, and software engineering technologies based on evolving platform needs.
  

**Qualifications**

* **3–5 years of experience** in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or similar technology roles.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in **SQL and Python** , with experience developing production data and analytics solutions.
* Strong experience with **dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks** , including data modeling, transformation, testing, documentation, and reusable development patterns.
* Strong understanding of **data modeling and data warehousing** , including **Kimball dimensional modeling, fact and dimension design, star schemas, and analytical data structures** .
* Good understanding of **ETL/ELT, data pipelines, orchestration, data quality, and modern analytics architecture** .
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms such as **BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent** , with working knowledge of GCP, AWS, or Azure.
* Experience with **Git and modern software engineering practices** , with exposure to CI/CD and automation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and **problem-solving skills** , with the ability to navigate ambiguous technical problems and develop scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated curiosity and ability to **learn and adopt new technologies** across data, cloud, DevOps, software engineering, and AI.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, and business teams.
  

**Good to Have**

* Experience with **Temporal,** **Airflow/Cloud Composer, Fivetran** , **Kafka,** or similar data technologies.
* Practical experience using **AI/Generative AI for analytics, data engineering, development, testing, or automation** .
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as **Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code** , or similar solutions.
* Exposure to **Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps/CI/CD** .
* Experience with observability technologies such as **Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry** , or equivalent.
* Familiarity with **APIs, backend services, or full-stack development** for building self-service platform experiences.
* Understanding of **metadata, lineage, data governance, and data observability** concepts.
* Any certifications in any of these areas - Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure), dbt, AI, and Devops
* Interest or experience in **platform engineering and product thinking** , particularly building reusable capabilities rather than one-time solutions.

Global Commercial Leader - IDS

In this role, you will have the opportunity to manage and own global commercial enablement initiatives and digital tools that support business growth and commercial excellence. You will collaborate closely with global, regional, and cross-functional stakeholders to enhance sales effectiveness, improve commercial processes, and accelerate digital transformation across the organization. You will also play a key role in developing training programs, optimizing bid and proposal processes, improving commercial reporting, and supporting pricing strategies for digital and software offerings.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Managing sales enablement initiatives, including training programs, webinars, learning sessions, and development of commercial enablement content and tools.
* Standardizing and continuously improving bid and proposal processes, performance metrics, and adoption of AI-enabled proposal solutions.
* Supporting digital opportunity reporting, performance analytics, recurring revenue tracking, and subscription business management through effective data governance and collaboration.

**Our team dynamics**

You will join a collaborative, globally diverse team, where you will have the opportunity to help shape commercial transformation initiatives, work with digital technologies, and contribute to ABB's growth strategy.

**Qualifications for the role**

* You are highly skilled in commercial operations, sales enablement, pricing management, business analytics, and digital transformation within a B2B environment.

* You are focused on stakeholder collaboration, project management, process improvement, and promoting adoption of digital and AI-enabled solutions.

* Work in a global role with broad exposure across regions, business lines, and leadership teams.
* Support digital transformation and commercial excellence initiatives that impact business performance.
* Collaborate with industry experts and cross-functional teams in a highly innovative environment.
* Contribute to the adoption of emerging technologies and AI-enabled solutions within commercial operations.

**More about us**

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry knowledge coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

jobs.title: NPD Manager – Nutraceuticals & Functional Foods
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad (in-office)

**Function:**
R&D & New Product Development

**Reports to:**
Founders

Earthful is a clean-label, plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures, and recently featured on Shark Tank India. Every product we sell starts as a brief written here. This role owns that journey from idea to a product on the shelf: the formulation, the trials, the evidence behind the claims, and the partners who make it.

**Role Overview**

You'll own new product development and improvement of existing products across supplements, functional foods, and wellness, working through contract manufacturers, third-party formulators, and ingredient vendors. You'll work directly with the founders on what to build, with Regulatory & Compliance on claims and labels, with Procurement on ingredients and packaging, and with Brand, Design, and Growth on launch. The job rewards people who can combine scientific judgment with speed, cost discipline, and follow-through.

**What You'll Own**

**Concept to Formulation Brief**

• Turn product concepts and consumer insight into clear, testable briefs for formulators and manufacturing partners

• Research ingredients, formats, and dosages for new wellness and supplement products

• Benchmark competitor products across India and global markets on formulation, claims, pricing, and positioning

• Develop across formats: powders, gummies, capsules, tablets, sachets, and others as the range grows

**Formulation & Product Trials**

• Own formulation development, from first sample to approved pilot batch

• Track every iteration — sensory trials, stability results, scale-up outcomes — and decide what moves forward and what is rejected

• Evaluate products on taste, mixability, texture, aroma, appearance, and usability

• Maintain structured documentation of trials, observations, and formulation changes

**Ingredient & Claims Research**

• Evaluate functional ingredients for dosage, evidence, usage restrictions, and clean-label suitability

• Build the claim substantiation file for each product — literature, references, and product rationale — before artwork is finalized

• Stay current on trends in women's health, gut health, protein, sleep and stress, and preventive wellness

**Vendor & Manufacturer Coordination**

• Coordinate with ingredient suppliers, contract manufacturers, and testing labs on samples, timelines, COAs, specifications, MOQs, and trial batches

• Support sourcing of ingredients and packaging components for new launches

• Compare vendors on quality, responsiveness, cost, and scalability, and give Procurement the technical input to negotiate

**Quality & Compliance Support**

• Own product specifications, ingredient sheets, and test reports for every product you develop

• Provide accurate label inputs, and work with Regulatory & Compliance on classification and claim alignment before launch

**Launch Readiness**

• Work with Brand, Design, Operations, and Growth so every product is ready on the launch date

• Translate technical product details into simple consumer-facing benefits

• Brief internal teams through launch decks, product notes, and FAQs

**Cost & Existing Product Improvement**

• Hold each formulation to a target cost of goods set at the brief stage, and flag early when a design choice puts it at risk

• Use consumer reviews, complaints, and operational feedback to prioritize improvements to existing products

• Use AI tools for literature and competitor research, verifying dosage, regulatory limits, and citations before anything is relied upon

• Education qualification - B Pharma, M Pharma, Pharmacognosy, Food technology

**What We're Looking For**

• 6–8 years of hands-on experience in NPD, R&D, or product development in supplements, nutraceuticals, functional foods, or FMCG wellness - who can independently lead the development activities.

• Brand-side experience: has taken products from brief to commercial launch through contract manufacturers or third-party formulators at a D2C or consumer brand — not only in-house at a manufacturer

• Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Nutrition, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related life-sciences field

• Working knowledge of FSSAI regulations for nutraceuticals and functional foods, and of claim substantiation

• Hands-on formulation experience in more than one format (powders, gummies, capsules, tablets, sachets)

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and disciplined documentation habits

• Consumer-first thinking and curiosity about what makes a product work in the market

• Comfortable in a fast-moving startup with high ownership and direct access to the founders

jobs.description:
**Position: Credit Controller**

**Company:** HRD Antwerp  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Experience:** 10+ Years  
**Location:** Mumbai (BKC)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Credit Controller** to join our Finance Department.

The incumbent will be responsible for independently managing the organisation's credit control function, ensuring timely collection of outstanding payments, monitoring customer credit exposure, and maintaining effective receivables management processes.

The role requires strong experience in B2B collections, customer account management, payment follow-ups, credit risk monitoring, and financial reporting. The candidate will work closely with clients, Business Development, Sales, and internal Finance teams to minimise overdue receivables, improve collection efficiency, and strengthen the organisation's cash flow.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Credit Control & Collection Management**

* Independently manage the organisation's credit control and collection activities.
* Monitor customer outstanding balances and ensure timely collection of receivables.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with clients through emails, calls, and other communication channels for overdue payments.
* Track payment commitments and ensure timely follow-up until outstanding amounts are settled.
* Proactively manage overdue accounts and minimise long-pending receivables.
* Drive collection targets and ensure timely recovery of outstanding payments.
* Monitor customer payment behaviour and take necessary follow-up actions to improve collection efficiency.

  

**2. Credit Risk Management**

* Monitor customer credit exposure and identify accounts with overdue or outstanding payments.
* Identify potential credit risks and escalate long-pending or high-value outstanding accounts to management.
* Support the implementation and monitoring of credit control procedures.
* Ensure adherence to company credit policies and payment terms.
* Highlight customers with recurring payment delays and recommend appropriate follow-up or escalation measures.
* Monitor customer credit limits and payment behaviour to minimise financial exposure.
* Recommend suitable credit control measures for customers with a history of delayed payments.

  

**3. Coordination with Internal Teams**

* Coordinate closely with Business Development and Sales teams for payment collection and recovery.
* Work with internal stakeholders to resolve customer payment-related concerns and collection delays.
* Provide regular updates on customer outstanding balances and payment status.
* Facilitate effective communication between clients and internal departments to ensure smooth resolution of payment issues.
* Escalate critical collection matters to the relevant stakeholders and management.
* Ensure timely coordination between Finance and Business Development teams to achieve collection targets.

  

**4. Customer Account Reconciliation & Dispute Resolution**

* Perform regular reconciliation of customer accounts and ledger balances.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, payments, credit notes, and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and customers to resolve billing and payment disputes.
* Ensure accurate recording and allocation of customer payments in the accounting system.
* Maintain proper documentation and records of reconciliations and payment adjustments.

  

**5. MIS & Receivables Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain periodic MIS reports on receivables, collection targets, and outstanding balances.
* Prepare and monitor customer-wise ageing reports and overdue payment reports.
* Track collection performance against targets and provide regular updates to management.
* Maintain accurate records of customer follow-ups, payment commitments, and collection status.
* Analyse receivables trends and highlight significant overdue balances and potential collection risks.
* Provide periodic reports and insights to management on collection performance and debtor ageing.

  

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience in Credit Control, Collections, Accounts Receivable, or Finance & Accounts.
* Strong understanding of credit control processes, receivables management, and collection strategies.
* Proven experience in handling B2B customer collections, overdue payments, and credit risk management.
* Good knowledge of customer ledger reconciliation, accounts ageing analysis, and receivables reporting.
* Experience in independently managing customer accounts and driving collection targets.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, follow-up, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer accounts and ensure timely collection of outstanding payments.

  

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Prior experience in independently managing Credit Control and collection functions.
* Experience in handling B2B customer collections and managing high-value outstanding receivables.
* Strong understanding of credit management, payment terms, customer credit exposure, and collection strategies.
* Experience in preparing ageing reports, collection MIS, and receivables dashboards.
* Ability to work closely with Business Development, Sales, and Finance teams to drive payment recovery.
* A proactive, organised, detail-oriented, and result-driven professional with a strong focus on collections and cash flow management.

jobs.title: AGM-IR

**Role & responsibilities**

* Protect **workers’ rights** while supporting business goals
* Provide a structured **grievance redressal mechanism**

**2. Key Stakeholders**

1. **Management**

* Plant Head, HR/IR Manager, Line Managers

2. **Employees / Workmen**

* Permanent, contract, trainees

3. **Trade Unions**

* Recognized and unrecognized unions

4. **Government / Labor Authorities**

* Labor Department, Conciliation Officer, Labor Court

**3. Core IR Functions in a Plant**

**A. Union & Collective Bargaining**

* Union recognition
* Wage negotiations
* Settlement of charter of demands
* Long-term wage agreements (2–5 years)

**B. Discipline Management**

* Standing Orders / Service Rules
* Domestic enquiries
* Handling misconduct (late coming, absenteeism, insubordination)
* Disciplinary actions (warning, suspension, dismissal)

**C. Grievance Handling**

* Shop-floor grievance resolution
* Grievance committee meetings
* Escalation mechanism (Supervisor HR Management)

**D. Statutory Compliance (India)**

* Industrial Disputes Act, 1947
* Factories Act, 1948
* Trade Unions Act, 1926
* Contract Labour (R&A) Act, 1970
* Payment of Wages Act
* Minimum Wages Act
* Standing Orders Act
* Bonus, PF, ESI compliances

**E. Contract Labour Management**

* Contractor registration & licensing
* Wage parity & compliance
* Avoiding sham contracts
* Managing unionization of contract workers

**4. Industrial Disputes in Plants**

Common causes:

* Wages & benefits
* Shift changes / working hours
* Promotions & transfers
* Disciplinary actions
* Contract labour issues

Forms of disputes:

* Go-slow
* Sit-in / tool-down strikes
* Lockouts
* Work stoppages

**5. Role of IR Manager in a Plant**

* Maintain **cordial relations** with unions
* Handle negotiations & settlements

jobs.description:
Chassis - Steering Engineer

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Automotive Steering System Design Engineer with 3-9 years of relevant experience in the design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle steering systems. * The candidate should have strong technical knowledge of Electric Power Steering (EPS), steering columns, steering gears, tie rods, steering geometry, vehicle packaging, steering performance, and vehicle-level integration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Steering System Design Development**

Design and develop complete steering systems for Passenger Cars, SUVs, EVs, or Commercial Vehicles.

Define steering-system architecture based on vehicle requirements.

Support selection and development of:

a.    Electric Power Steering (EPS)

b.    Column-EPS (C-EPS)

c.    Pinion-EPS (P-EPS)

d.    Rack-EPS (R-EPS)

e.    Hydraulic Power Steering (HPS), where applicable

Define steering-system performance and functional requirements.

Support steering-system development from concept through production release.

**2. Steering Component Design**

Design, develop, and integrate components including:

1.    Steering wheel

2.    Steering column

3.    Intermediate shaft

4.    Universal joints

5.    Steering gear / rack and pinion

6.    Tie rods

7.    Inner and outer ball joints

8.    EPS motor and ECU interfaces

9.    Steering mounting brackets

10.    Steering boots and associated components

**3. Steering Geometry Engineering**

Define and evaluate steering geometry.

Work on key steering parameters including:

a.    Steering ratio

b.    Turning radius

c.    Ackermann geometry

d.    King Pin Inclination

e.    Caster

f.    Trail

g.    Scrub radius

h.    Rack travel

i.    Wheel angle

Perform steering-effort and system-level engineering calculations.

Evaluate steering kinematics across the complete wheel and suspension travel range.

**4. EPS Electronic Steering Integration**

Support EPS selection, packaging, and integration.

Coordinate EPS motor, ECU, torque sensor, and vehicle electrical interfaces.

Work with Controls and Electrical/Electronics teams for EPS functionality.

Support steering assist, returnability, on-center feel, and steering response development.

Knowledge of Steer-by-Wire, ADAS steering functions, and automated-driving interfaces will be an advantage.

**5. CAD Design Vehicle Packaging**

Develop and review steering-system 3D models and 2D drawings.

Perform vehicle-level packaging studies.

Check steering-column and intermediate-shaft routing.

Perform clearance and interference analysis throughout steering and suspension travel.

Ensure integration with:

a.    Suspension

b.    Brakes

c.    Wheels and tyres

d.    Instrument panel

e.    Powertrain

f.    Battery systems for EV applications

Conduct tolerance stack-up studies and apply GDT requirements.

Preferred CAD Tools: CATIA V5 / CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE / Siemens NX

**6. CAE Vehicle Dynamics**

Work closely with CAE and Vehicle Dynamics teams for:

1.    Structural analysis

2.    Durability analysis

3.    Steering-system stiffness

4.    Steering kinematics

5.    NVH analysis

6.    Vehicle handling

7.    Steering response

8.    Steering effort

Experience with Adams Car, ANSYS, Abaqus, HyperMesh, MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalent tools will be an advantage.

**7. Testing Validation**

Prepare DVPR for steering-system components and complete vehicle systems.

Support component-, subsystem-, and vehicle-level validation.

Evaluate:

a.    Steering effort

b.    Steering response

c.    Returnability

d.    On-center feel

e.    Free play

f.    Turning radius

g.    Parking effort

h.    Noise and vibration

i.    Durability

j.    High-speed stability

Analyze test results and identify root causes for steering-related issues.

Recommend design modifications and corrective actions.

**8. Supplier Cross-Functional Coordination**

Prepare steering-system technical specifications.

Conduct technical reviews with steering-system suppliers.

Review supplier drawings, specifications, DFMEA, validation plans, and test reports.

Support supplier design and development activities.

Coordinate with Suspension, Brakes, Vehicle Dynamics, ADAS, Controls, Electrical/Electronics, CAE, Testing, Manufacturing, and Vehicle Integration teams.

Support engineering changes and design release activities.

**Required Technical Skills**

Automotive steering-system architecture

Electric Power Steering (EPS)

Rack Pinion Steering

Steering column and intermediate shaft

Steering geometry

Ackermann geometry

Steering ratio and turning radius

Steering effort calculations

Vehicle dynamics fundamentals

Suspension and steering integration

Vehicle-level packaging

GDT and tolerance stack-up

DFMEA

DVPR

Engineering change management

Root-cause analysis

EV / Advanced Steering Skills - Preferred

Electric Power Steering integration

EPS control interface

ADAS steering integration

Lane Keep Assist steering interface

Automated-driving steering functions

Steer-by-Wire fundamentals

Functional-safety awareness for electronically controlled steering systems

**Preferred Software Knowledge**

CAD: CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE / Siemens NX

Vehicle Dynamics: MSC Adams / Adams Car

CAE: ANSYS / Abaqus / HyperMesh

Controls: MATLAB / Simulink

PLM: Teamcenter / ENOVIA or equivalent

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in Passenger Cars, SUVs, EVs, or Commercial Vehicles.

Experience in complete steering-system development from concept, design and packaging through validation and production release.

Experience working with steering/EPS suppliers.

Exposure to vehicle dynamics, ADAS, EPS calibration, or Steer-by-Wire is preferred.

Key Competencies

Strong automotive steering-domain knowledge

Steering-system design and integration

Vehicle packaging

Engineering calculations

Vehicle dynamics understanding

Root-cause analysis

Supplier technical coordination

Cross-functional engineering coordination

jobs.title: Chassis- Brakes Engineer
jobs.description:
**Chassis- Brakes Engineer**

  

**Job Summary**

  

  
* We are looking for an experienced Automotive Brake System Design Engineer with 3-9 years of relevant experience in the design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle braking systems.
  
* The candidate should have strong knowledge of foundation brakes, hydraulic brake systems, brake actuation, ABS/ESC, parking brake systems, brake performance, vehicle integration, and brake system validation.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Brake System Design & Development**

  

  
* Design and develop complete vehicle braking systems for Passenger Cars, SUVs, EVs, or Commercial Vehicles.
  
* Define braking-system architecture and performance requirements.
  
* Perform brake-system sizing based on vehicle mass, GVW, axle loads, tyre size, vehicle speed, and braking targets.
  
* Define front-to-rear brake force distribution and brake balance.
  
* Support braking-system design from concept through production release.
  

  

**2. Brake Component Design**

  

  
* Design, develop, package, and integrate components such as:
  
* Disc brake assemblies
  
* Brake calipers
  
* Brake discs / rotors
  
* Brake pads
  
* Drum brakes
  
* Master cylinder
  
* Brake booster
  
* Brake pedal assembly
  
* Hydraulic brake lines and hoses
  
* ABS / ESC hydraulic control unit
  
* Parking brake systems
  
* Electric Parking Brake (EPB)
  

  

**3. Brake Performance Engineering**

  

  
* Perform engineering calculations and assessments for:
  
* Braking force
  
* Brake torque
  
* Stopping distance
  
* Brake balance
  
* Pedal force
  
* Hydraulic pressure
  
* Brake thermal capacity
  
* Disc sizing
  
* Heat generation and dissipation
  
* Brake fade performance
  
* Support performance evaluation under different vehicle loading and operating conditions.
  

  

**4. ABS / ESC & Electronic Brake Integration**

  

  
* Support vehicle-level integration of ABS and ESC systems.
  
* Coordinate with Controls, Electrical/Electronics, Vehicle Dynamics, and suppliers for brake-control integration.
  
* Support wheel-speed sensor and related component packaging.
  
* Knowledge of Brake-by-Wire, Electronic Brake Booster, or Integrated Brake Systems will be an advantage.
  
* For EV applications, understanding of regenerative braking and friction-brake blending is preferred.
  

  

**5. CAD Design & Vehicle Integration**

  

  
* Develop and review 3D models and 2D drawings for brake components.
  
* Perform packaging studies for brake assemblies, wheels, tyres, suspension, steering, and surrounding components.
  
* Conduct clearance and interference checks.
  
* Perform tolerance stack-up and apply GD&T requirements.
  
* Support engineering change and design release activities.
  
* Preferred CAD Tools: CATIA V5 / CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE / Siemens NX
  

  

**6. CAE & Thermal Analysis**

  

  
* Work closely with CAE teams for:
  
* Brake thermal analysis
  
* Structural analysis
  
* Fatigue analysis
  
* Disc stress and deformation analysis
  
* Brake component durability
  
* NVH analysis
  
* Experience with tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, HyperMesh, or equivalent CAE software is preferred.
  

  

**7. Brake Testing & Validation**

  

  
* Prepare and execute DVP&R for brake-system components and vehicle-level braking performance.
  
* Support brake dynamometer and vehicle testing.
  
* Evaluate:
  
* a. Stopping distance
  
* b. Brake fade and recovery
  
* c. Pedal feel
  
* d. Brake efficiency
  
* e. Hot and cold braking performance
  
* f. Parking brake performance
  
* g. Brake noise and vibration
  
* h. Wet brake performance
  
* i. High-speed braking
  
* Analyze test results and initiate corrective actions for identified issues.
  

  

**8. Engineering & Supplier Coordination**

  

  
* Prepare technical specifications and engineering requirements.
  
* Review supplier technical proposals, drawings, specifications, and validation reports.
  
* Conduct design reviews and supplier technical discussions.
  
* Support DFMEA, DVP&R, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution.
  
* Coordinate with Suspension, Steering, Vehicle Integration, Vehicle Dynamics, CAE, Electrical/Electronics, Controls, Testing, Manufacturing, and Supplier teams.

jobs.title: RGM Lead
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations

****Your Role****   
  

The RGM Lead sits within the CI RGM Pricing Pod and leads advanced revenue-growth-management analytics and decision support across pricing, promotions, pack-price architecture, trade investment and channel / mix strategy. The role converts elasticity, gross-to-net, regulatory and commercial evidence into recommendations that improve sustainable net revenue, margin and trade-investment returns, while setting analytical standards and developing RGM capability across the team.

  

****In this role you will play key role in****   
  

* Lead analysis of price elasticity, price gaps, willingness-to-pay and promotion effectiveness across brands, packs, channels and markets; distinguish true incremental volume from subsidized baseline sales.
* Own pricing and trade-spend scenario modelling, including list-price / net-price bridges, gross-to-net waterfalls, promotional depth and frequency, trade terms, and trade-investment ROI.
* Recommend pack-price architecture, price ladders, mix and channel strategies that balance consumer affordability, competitive position, revenue, margin and share objectives.
* Provide RGM input into pricing cycles, annual operating plans, forecasts and commercial reviews, translating model outputs into clear decisions, risks and value opportunities.
* Assess the commercial impact of changes in excise, tax, minimum-pricing, price-cap, promotion and other relevant regulatory requirements; develop scenarios and mitigation options with Finance, Legal / Regulatory and Commercial teams.
* Lead cross-functional RGM workstreams with Sales, Finance, Category, Brand, Insights and market teams, ensuring aligned assumptions, approved methodologies and traceable recommendations.
* Establish analytical standards, model QA, assumptions governance and reusable scenario templates; improve automation and repeatability using SQL and, where appropriate, Python / R.
* Coach and upskill new and existing team members on elasticity, pricing mechanics, trade terms, gross-to-net, promotion analytics and RGM storytelling; review complex outputs before senior stakeholder use.

  

****Your Profile****   
  

* 12+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Growth Management, pricing, commercial analytics, category / customer strategy or related CPG / FMCG roles, with significant hands-on pricing and trade-investment experience.
* Strong quantitative and modelling capability using advanced Microsoft Excel and SQL; practical Python / R exposure is valuable for scalable modelling and sensitivity analysis.
* Deep understanding of price elasticity and willingness-to-pay approaches; experience with conjoint / discrete-choice modelling or comparable pricing research techniques is strongly preferred.
* Strong command of pricing mechanics, price-pack architecture, trade terms, promotion effectiveness, gross-to-net waterfalls and trade-investment ROI.
* Working knowledge of excise, tax and pricing / promotion regulation and the ability to model the commercial impact of regulatory changes.
* Ability to connect consumer, competitor, customer and financial evidence into commercially actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
* Proven experience coaching analysts, governing model quality and raising RGM capability across a team or distributed delivery environment.

  

****What you will love working here****   
  

* Exposure to cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and data-led decision making.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture focused on innovation and continuous learning.
* Global career growth opportunities across diverse industries and markets.
* Work with talented professionals who are passionate about creating business impact and delivering excellence.

jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**Job Summary**

Responsible for conducting and documenting regulatory toxicological assessments for pharmaceutical APIs and impurities, including nitrosamine risk assessments, in-silico mutagenicity evaluations, Permitted Daily Exposure (PDE) assessments, and Occupational Exposure Limit (OEL) assessments in accordance with applicable regulatory guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Nitrosamine Risk Assessment**

* Conduct nitrosamine risk assessments for pharmaceutical APIs and drug products in accordance with applicable regulatory guidance, including FDA, EMA, and ICH recommendations.
* Evaluate potential nitrosamine formation, contamination risks, and N-nitrosamine drug substance-related impurities (NDSRIs).
* Assess acceptable intake (AI) limits and permissible impurity limits based on applicable regulatory guidance.
* Review and interpret regulatory updates concerning nitrosamine impurities.

**Mutagenicity and Genotoxicity Assessment**

* Review bacterial reverse mutation (Ames) test data and relevant literature.
* Assess the need for additional testing, including Enhanced Ames Test (EAT), where applicable.
* Coordinate with external laboratories for study initiation, sample dispatch, protocol review, data follow-up, and report evaluation.
* Review study findings and prepare scientific justifications to address regulatory queries.

**In-Silico Toxicological Assessment**

* Perform mutagenicity assessments using computational toxicology tools such as Derek and Sarah Nexus, as applicable.
* Conduct QSAR assessments using CaseUltra or equivalent software.
* Interpret structural alerts, supporting databases, experimental Ames data, and structurally relevant reference compounds.
* Prepare scientifically justified expert judgement reports for the assessment and dismissal of alerts, where appropriate.
* Evaluate available experimental data and determine the need for additional testing based on the weight of evidence.

**PDE and OEL Assessment**

* Perform toxicological assessments to establish PDE and OEL values for pharmaceutical APIs and impurities.
* Identify and evaluate relevant toxicological endpoints, NOAEL/LOAEL values, and supporting published literature.
* Apply appropriate uncertainty factors and route-specific considerations in accordance with applicable guidance.
* Prepare scientifically justified toxicological reports and occupational exposure assessments.

**Regulatory Research and Documentation**

* Review relevant guidelines, including ICH M7, IVH Q3B, ICH S9, and applicable nitrosamine guidance
* Conduct literature searches and evaluate relevant nonclinical and clinical safety data.
* Prepare technical reports, risk assessment documents, and responses to regulatory queries.
* Maintain traceable references, supporting evidence, and audit ready documentation

**Cross-functional coordination**

* Coordinate with Regulatory affairs, quality Assurance, R and D and other relevant teams
* Communicate with external laboratories and consultants regarding toxicology studies and technical requirements
* Support internal; review, audits and regulatory submission related to toxicological assessments.

**Required Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Toxicology, Regulatory Toxicology, Pharmacy Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a relevant life-sciences discipline.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical toxicology, genotoxicity, impurity assessment, and regulatory guidelines.
* Experience with Scientific literature review and technical report preparation

**About the Role**

Responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end product development, formulation development, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and supply-chain activities for nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, personal care and allied product categories.

The role involves translating client requirements and market opportunities into commercially viable products through coordination with contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, internal business development teams and quality/regulatory functions.

**Key Responsibilities**A. Product Development & NPD

· Manage the product development lifecycle from initial concept and client requirement assessment to formulation finalisation, sampling, validation and commercial manufacturing.

· Evaluate new product opportunities based on market trends, consumer requirements, ingredient innovations and commercial feasibility.

· Coordinate with contract manufacturers and technical teams for new product development across nutraceutical, functional food, pharmaceutical and personal care categories.

· Drive formulation development, optimisation and improvement in terms of ingredient selection, active concentrations, excipient systems, flavour profiles, stability and product performance.

· Evaluate innovative delivery formats, including gummies, powders, sachets, tablets, capsules, liquids, RTDs and other functional formats.

· Coordinate prototype development, sample evaluation, sensory assessment and subsequent formulation modifications.

· Prepare and manage New Product Development (NPD/NPDP) documentation and development timelines.

· Coordinate technical feasibility assessments for new ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and product formats.

B. Contract Manufacturing, Technical Coordination and Scale up

· Identify, evaluate and coordinate with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Conduct manufacturing facility visits and technical assessments to evaluate production capabilities, infrastructure, processes and quality systems.

· Coordinate product development and commercial manufacturing activities with external manufacturing partners.

· Review manufacturing feasibility, process limitations, production capacities, minimum order quantities and lead times.

· Monitor manufacturing progress, identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to ensure timely execution.

· Establish manufacturing timelines and align internal and external stakeholders on development, procurement, production and dispatch schedules.

· Coordinate with manufacturing partners for process improvements, production optimisation and resolution of technical issues.

C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control Coordination

· Coordinate manufacturer QA/QC teams to establish and maintain product quality standards.

· Review product specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), raw material documentation and finished product quality parameters.

· Establish and coordinate quality checkpoints across product development, sampling, manufacturing and finished goods evaluation.

· Coordinate product testing, analytical evaluation, stability studies and quality investigations.

· Review product samples for sensory attributes, physical characteristics and compliance with agreed specifications.

· Identify quality deviations and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with manufacturing partners.

· Ensure alignment between approved product specifications, manufacturing requirements and final commercial batches.

· Support quality documentation and product release-related activities.

D. Regulatory Affairs & Compliance

· Coordinate regulatory requirements for product development, manufacturing and commercialisation.

· Support FSSAI compliance, including product documentation, ingredient permissibility, product categorisation and labelling requirements.

· Review product labels, ingredient declarations, nutritional information, claims and regulatory artwork.

· Coordinate with regulatory teams and manufacturing partners for required licences, certifications, declarations and technical documentation.

· Support preparation and review of Free Sale Certificates, product descriptions, technical dossiers and other export-related documentation.

· Coordinate regulatory feasibility assessments for domestic and international product opportunities.

· Ensure product development and commercialisation activities remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Product Costing & Commercial Feasibility

· Coordinate product costing exercises for new and existing products.

You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

jobs.title: Senior Scientist - R&D Analytical
jobs.description:
**Senior Scientist, R&D Analytical**

**Role reports to:** Principal Scientist, R&D Analytical

**Location :** Mulund, Mumbai

  

**What you will do**

The Senior Scientist position will be a part of the team that is responsible for analytical deliverables of new product development projects, support changes to existing products and specific research-based activities, product investigations, etc. assigned as a part of Global operations. The delivery of the projects is expected to meet applicable compliance and quality requirements and established performance metrics. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the safety and quality of consumer health products through the use of advanced analytical instruments such as ICP-MS, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, focused on trace level impurities accurate quantification to support regulatory submissions and contribute to the scientific understanding of the impurities.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, validate, and transfer LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, ICP-MS, etc methods for accurately quantifying impurities (e.g., elemental impurities, residual solvents, extractables & leachable, nitrosamines, etc.) at trace levels (ppm to sub-ppb) with MS for their risk assessment and mitigation strategies.
* Utilize mass spectrometry and other analytical instruments to solve complex structural and quantitative problems.
* Strong skills in method development, optimization, verification/validation and deep understanding of chemistry principles and formulation design aspects for test methods.
* Validate and transfer analytical methods to support product development and life cycle management projects.
* Conduct chemical extraction studies on container closure systems and consumer products to identify potential E&L, elemental impurities, residual solvents.
* Conduct method optimization, stability studies, and shelf-life assessments.
* Perform testing using HPLC/UPLC, GC, IC, AAS, and other advanced instrumentation.
* Manage method transfers to internal/external labs and manufacturing sites.
* Coordinate outsourcing of analytical operations and research projects when required.
* Author technical documents e.g., method development summary, method validation reports, method transfer, test methods, etc.

* Deep technical expertise related to chemistry, analytical techniques, method development, validation, stability, and research technologies. Solid understanding of analytical and physical testing capabilities.
* Capable of applying diversified expertise in technical principles and practices in broad chemistry areas or technology.

**Job Title:** Buyer Vitamins & Additives  
 **Location:** HO Mumbai

  

**About Godrej Agrovet Limited (GAVL)**

Godrej Agrovet Limited (GAVL) is a diversified, research-driven agribusiness company and a part of the Godrej Industries Group. The company operates across Animal Feed, Crop Protection, Oil Palm, Dairy, Poultry & Processed Foods, serving the needs of farmers and businesses across India.

The Animal Nutrition Business is one of the largest organized animal feed businesses in India, offering nutrition solutions for cattle, poultry, aqua, and specialty segments. Through its Central Buying Organization (CBO), GAVL drives strategic sourcing and procurement excellence to ensure a reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable supply chain.

  

**Job Purpose**

Responsible for end-to-end procurement of vitamins, additives, functional supplements, amino acids, and minerals sourced domestically and internationally for use in animal feed/pet food manufacturing. The candidate should possess a strong foundation in chemistry and related sciences, with an interest in procurement, sourcing, market analysis, and import operations. Must be willing to travel for market studies, vendor interactions, and project execution.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Procurement Planning and Execution

* Manage procurement of Vitamins & Additives portfolio for multiple businesses and factories in GAVL and execute procurement strategies to achieve business objectives.
* Prepare annual budgets with reasonable cost estimates and ensure spend remains within budget norms.
* Lead sourcing by performing periodic spend analysis, inventory controls, rejection reduction, etc., to align procurement actions with business plans. Make best use of digital platforms and ERP solutions to gather insights related to spend management.
* Support contract negotiations, pricing discussions, payment terms, and Incoterms while maintaining strong supplier relationships.

Strategic & Global Sourcing

* Identify, assess, and develop a network of reliable global and local suppliers to ensure uninterrupted, cost-effective, and quality-compliant supply of key ingredients.
* Continuously scan domestic and international market trends and price dynamics to support buying decisions.

Stakeholder Collaboration

* Collaborate with stakeholders across Manufacturing, R&D, Nutrition, Quality, Finance, and Regulatory teams.
* Evaluate product specifications and supplier capabilities with Nutrition and R&D teams to ensure technical suitability and compliance with formulation requirements.
* Keep track of new developments, molecules, and alternatives in the Additives category and work with stakeholders to identify implementation opportunities within GAVL.

Import Operations Management

* Support end-to-end import processes, including vendor communication, documentation, customs clearance coordination, CHA interactions, and compliance with international trade and port regulations.
* Assess CHA and logistics partners for efficiency and responsiveness to business needs.
* Ensure all imported and domestic materials meet statutory and internal compliance norms (FSSAI, BIS, GMP, DGFT, etc.) with complete documentation and audit readiness.

Market Intelligence & Risk Management

* Track trends in global commodity and Vitamins & Additives markets, foreign exchange, freight, and regulatory environments to support short-term and long-term buying decisions, risk mitigation, and cost optimization.
* Be willing to travel across India for vendor development, industry conferences, market assessments, and business support activities.

Supplier Relationship & Performance Management

* Build supplier partnerships and monitor performance on delivery, quality, and service metrics. Support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist in vendor identification and onboarding activities to enhance the supplier base and ensure competitive sourcing.

Key Competencies

* Basic knowledge of vitamins, amino acids, supplement molecules (e.g., choline chloride, betaine), additives, and minerals.
* Understanding of procurement, sourcing, supply chain, imports, or related concepts through academics, internships, or projects.
* Awareness of import documentation, customs processes, and international trade compliance.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and willingness to learn ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.).
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Exposure to regulatory frameworks such as FSSAI, BIS, GMP, HACCP, or related standards will be an advantage.

  

**Qualifications**

* **B.Sc. in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Life Sciences, Agriculture, Food Technology, or related disciplines.**
* Freshers or candidates with **0 to 1 year of experience**.
* Internships, academic projects, or certifications related to procurement, supply chain, imports, chemicals, food, pharma, animal nutrition, or nutraceuticals will be preferred.
* Strong academic foundation and willingness to build a career in Procurement and Supply Chain Management.

jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This position involves managing and optimizing upstream manufacturing operations, including microbial fermentation, media preparation, inoculum development, and microbial algae cultivation. The role focuses on overseeing day-to-day production activities, optimizing fermentation parameters, improving biomass productivity, and ensuring consistent batch performance while meeting production targets and quality standards. The candidate should have exposure to the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, from microbial algae, along with a strong understanding of fermentation processes, process optimization, and scale-up. The role also requires effective coordination with downstream processing, quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day upstream manufacturing operations, including media preparation, sterilization, inoculum development, fermentation, and microbial algae cultivation.
* Supervise and monitor fermentation processes to ensure consistent biomass growth, product yield, and adherence to production schedules.
* Operate and oversee fermenters, bioreactors, seed vessels, media preparation systems, sterilization systems, and associated auxiliary equipment.
* Support upstream production of microbial biomass for the manufacture of omega oils, including DHA and EPA, derived from microbial algae.
* Monitor and optimize critical process parameters such as temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, agitation, aeration, nutrient feed, and fermentation duration.
* Perform media optimization, inoculum optimization, and process parameter optimization based on strain performance and production requirements.
* Troubleshoot fermentation-related issues, identify root causes of process deviations, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure proper execution of batch manufacturing activities, including batch documentation, process monitoring, yield tracking, and timely batch completion.
* Take responsibility for the successful execution of assigned batches, ensuring process consistency, productivity, and compliance with established specifications.
* Support process development, technology transfer, and scale-up activities from laboratory or pilot scale to commercial manufacturing scale.
* Coordinate with downstream processing teams to ensure the timely transfer of fermentation broth or biomass for subsequent extraction and purification operations.
* Collaborate with quality assurance, quality control, maintenance, and engineering teams to address process deviations, equipment breakdowns, and operational challenges.
* Ensure compliance with applicable GMP requirements, SOPs, safety protocols, hygiene standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate production records, batch manufacturing records, equipment logbooks, and other relevant documentation.
* Monitor raw material and media requirements, coordinate procurement planning with relevant departments, and minimize material wastage.
* Assist in production planning, manpower allocation, shift scheduling, and resource utilization to achieve manufacturing targets within the approved budget.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost reduction, increased biomass productivity, improved fermentation yields, and enhanced operational efficiency.
* Lead and guide upstream production personnel, ensuring adherence to operating procedures, safety practices, and quality standards.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new technologies, automation systems, and process improvements in upstream manufacturing.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.
* Duties and responsibilities are not limited to the work listed above and may include other assignments as necessary

Qualifications, Competencies, and Position Requirements

* Strong technical knowledge of upstream bioprocessing, microbial fermentation, and bioreactor operations.
* Practical understanding of microbial algae cultivation and fermentation-based production of omega oils, particularly DHA and/or EPA, is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of media formulation, inoculum development, sterilization, aseptic techniques, and fermentation process control.
* Ability to monitor, analyze, and optimize critical process parameters to improve biomass productivity and product yield.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting, root cause analysis, process deviation management, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Familiarity with GMP, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, and industrial safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple production activities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Willingness to work in shifts, including night shifts, as required.
* Willingness to travel as required by the role.

***Education and Experience:***

* M.Tech, M.Sc., or Ph.D. in Biotechnology.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant industrial experience in upstream manufacturing, microbial fermentation, or bioprocess operations, preferably in the nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, food biotechnology, or microbial oil industry.
* Hands-on experience in industrial-scale fermentation, bioreactor operations, media optimization, and process parameter optimization is preferred.
* Exposure to microbial algae cultivation and the production of omega oils, particularly DHA and EPA, is desirable.
* Knowledge of GMP requirements, SOPs, batch manufacturing documentation, process troubleshooting, and quality standards is preferred.

***Travel:***

jobs.title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager for Application Lab of Personal Care & Home Care
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Application Lab Senior Executive / Assistant Manager develops tests and demonstrates personal care and home care formulations that showcase the company's principals' ingredients. The role bridges suppliers, sales teams and customers, turning raw material know-how into practical formulations, technical data and compelling presentations.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Skin Care Formulations

* Develop and optimise skin care prototypes – creams, lotions, serums, gels, sun care, cleansers and colour cosmetic bases – using the principals' emulsifiers, emollients, actives, UV filters, rheology modifiers, preservatives and sensory additives.
* Create benchmark and starting-point formulations that showcase ingredient performance, stability and sensory.
* Adapt customer formulas for ingredient substitution, cost optimisation, sustainability or regulatory change.
* Work on natural, vegan and clean beauty concepts in line with market trends.

2. Hair Care Formulations

* Develop shampoos, conditioners, masks, leave-on treatments, styling products, colorants and scalp-care formulations.
* Evaluate surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones and alternatives, and actives for claims such as anti-dandruff, repair, frizz control and colour protection.
* Run sulphate-free, silicone-free and bio-based formulation projects.

3. Home Care Support

* Support home care formulations (laundry, dishwash, surface and fabric care) as business needs require.

4. Testing and Performance Evaluation

* Test physico-chemical parameters: pH, viscosity, appearance, colour, odour, foam, SPF/UV and droplet size.
* Run stability (accelerated, freeze-thaw, light, centrifuge), compatibility and preservative efficacy studies, coordinating with external labs where needed.
* Conduct sensory panels and in-vitro/in-vivo claim support studies, including hair-tress and skin-feel evaluations.
* Maintain and calibrate lab instruments; ensure GLP, safety and housekeeping.

5. Innovation and Trend Monitoring

* Track global personal care trends, launches, regulations and competitor products; convert insights into concept formulations.
* Collaborate with principals on new ingredient launches and co-development projects.
* Propose new product concepts and sustainable, value-added solutions for the regional market.
* Capture market and consumer trends from market visits, customers, retail and competitor products; share insights and opportunity reports with sales, marketing and principals.

6. Trade Shows, Events and Customer Engagement

* Prepare and present formulations, samples and demo material at trade shows and conferences (e.g., in-cosmetics, HPCI, CHT, local exhibitions).
* Support technical seminars, lab tours and live application demonstrations.
* Support the sales team on customer visits, in person and virtual (video calls, online demos, webinars), with technical inputs, formulation discussions and follow-up.
* Join sales on market visits to brand owners, contract manufacturers and trade partners to understand requirements and opportunities.
* Provide technical troubleshooting to customers on formulation, stability, processing and performance issues – identify root causes and recommend corrective solutions.

7. Documentation

* Maintain accurate lab notebooks, formulation records, batch sheets and test reports.
* Prepare technical data sheets, formulation brochures, application notes and product dossiers with full traceability.
* Support sales and principals with technical documents, test data, certificates and customer queries.
* Support regulatory and compliance documentation (SDS, claims support, BIS, ISO 22716/GMP).
* Support sampling: prepare, label, pack and dispatch samples; track requests, feedback and conversions.
* Manage the formulation database, sample inventory and retention-sample library.

8. Presentations and Technical Communication

* Deliver technical presentations to customers, internal teams and principals, covering formulation results and project updates.
* Present case studies and performance data with clear visuals.
* Develop product application training for sales teams.
* Work with marketing on digital campaigns (webinars, e-mailers, social media, online content) and promotional material (brochures, flyers, application videos, case studies), ensuring technical accuracy.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* M.Sc / B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Pharm / M.Pharm in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Oils & Surfactants, Chemical or Pharmaceutical Technology.

**Experience**

* Senior Executive: 3–6 years; Assistant Manager: 6–10 years in personal care formulation (skin and hair care), in a lab, application or R&D role – preferably with a raw material supplier or distributor.
* Hands-on experience in emulsions, surfactant systems, sun care and hair care.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of cosmetic ingredients, INCI, stability and regulatory basics.
* Excellent presentation, communication and customer-facing skills.
* Proficient in MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel; formulation software is a plus.
* Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Collaborative, curious and innovative; willing to travel for trade shows and customer visits.

Works closely with Personal Care and Home Care sales and marketing, principals' technical teams, customers, and regulatory and quality functions.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Designation: Scientific Director

Job Location: Bengaluru, India

Department: Medicinal Chemistry – Drug Discovery

About Syngene

Syngene International Ltd. (BSE: 539268, NSE: SYNGENE, ISIN: INE398R01022), is an integrated research, development, and manufacturing services solutions company serving the global pharmaceutical, biotechnology, nutrition, animal health, consumer goods, and specialty chemical sectors. Syngene’s 4500+ scientists offer both skills and the capacity to deliver great science, robust data management and IP security and quality manufacturing, at speed, to improve time-to-market and lower the cost of innovation. With a combination of dedicated research facilities for Amgen, Baxter, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Herbalife, as well as 1.9 Mn sq ft of specialist discovery, development, and manufacturing facilities, Syngene works with biotech companies pursuing leading edge science as well as multinationals including GSK and Merck KGaA.

Job Purpose:

The scientist leads programs aimed at discovering new medicines. The role involves contributing to scientific direction, collaborating across disciplines to advance programs to decision points, and directly managing a team of PhD and associate medicinal chemists to achieve program goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Scientific leadership

* Collaborate with multidisciplinary team to formulate and test scientific hypotheses.
* Integrate data from across disciplines to iteratively design and test analogs in pursuit of target candidate profile. Use predictive, visualization and modeling tools effectively.
* Devise synthetic routes. Stay hands-on in the lab. Follow safety and electronic record keeping protocols.
* Keep current with pertinent scientific and technological advances. Seek opportunities to champion new methods. Take measured risks to develop differentiated synthesis and SAR strategies.
* Track the competitive landscape and adjust objectives and strategies accordingly.
* Assists with patent applications. Enable the program’s external communication plan through presentation or publication.

Program leadership

* Lead discovery programs by setting objectives and deliverables, devising strategies and allocating resources.
* Identify key issues and propose solutions. Make timely, evidence-based decisions, including when information is incomplete, to prioritize, redirect or stop lines of investigation, including compound progression.
* Represent Medicinal Chemistry on multidisciplinary teams. Present proposals and progress updates to stakeholders and governance bodies.

People management

* Directly manage a team of PhD and associate chemists. Own their goal-setting, results, performance management and development plans.
* Coach and mentor team members and colleagues. Delegate meaningful leadership responsibilities to train future leaders. Give timely feedback and address performance issues.
* Provide significant input on hiring, performance reviews, and promotions.

Technical Skills:

* Proficiency in medicinal and organic chemistry.
* Comprehensive knowledge of drug discovery principles, concepts and methods.
* Works independently and is experienced in making decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Persuades stakeholders to adopt a different point of view when appropriate.
* Clear written and verbal scientific communication. Tailors messages to the audience and anticipates objections.
* Builds relationships across disciplines and takes part in team decisions.
* Committed to continuous learning and growth.

Educational Qualification:

PhD in Synthetic Organic Chemistry or in Medicinal Chemistry.

Experience:

* 10+ years pharmaceutical industry, including 2+ years of program leadership
* Member of integrated medicinal chemistry programs.
* Proven record of innovative science in lead identification and multiparameter optimization, supported by peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations and patent inventorship.
* Managing and mentoring scientists.

Behavioral Skills:

* A proactive team player.
* Ensure completion of experiments and generate accurate and reproducible data from experiments.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and work on multiple projects simultaneously with; comfortable working in a dynamic environment with changing requirements.
* Good oral and written communication and presentation skills to work in a multi-disciplinary team.

Task Execution Under Pressure, Business Acumen, Commercial Awareness, Objective Setting, Accountability, Consumer Insight, R&D, Product Lifecycle Management, Intellectual Property, Business Partnership, Collaboration and partnership building, Adapt to changes in technological development plans, Ability to challenge the status quo and propose improvement, Innovation Processes.

* Knowledge in Quality and Food Safety Management System.

We are looking for a personable, articulate and commercially driven individual to join IFBE's venue sales team.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of culture, hospitality and business, building relationships with an interesting and diverse clientele while contributing directly to the growth of IFBE as a distinctive event and cultural destination.

jobs.title: Senior Programme Lead – Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)
jobs.company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water
jobs.description:
At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for as an employer. So, if the below description strikes a chord, we would love to hear from you!

**At CEEW, we build careers in public policy**

* We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale
* We actively promote leadership by initiative
* We celebrate talent and ambition
* You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow
* You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations
* Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility, come together at CEEW
* You will get above-market remuneration
* We provide a safe space for all
* At CEEW, your life is your example for others

**Designation offered**
  
Senior Programme Lead

**Reporting to**
  
Sustainable Food Systems (Political Economy)

**Location**
  
New Delhi, India

### **Purpose**

Systems change in food systems reform is impeded by entrenched political economy dynamics. We are looking for a leader who can not only navigate this political economy, but also orchestrate difficult, real change – rewriting political economy equations and enabling systemic transformation. They will build and lead a team working at the interface of political economy, public policy, and institutions, and will advance the Council’s research, policy engagement, and impact by helping the programme understand and navigate political economy while actively orchestrating systems-level change in India’s food systems.

### **Responsibilities and Duties**

**Strategy**

* Co-evolve the strategy for the programme’s political economy work, building on existing in-house thinking, the political economy landscape across food systems reform, our skillset and niche, the evolving sectoral narrative, and emerging government priorities.
* Work closely with the team to bring alignment within the team on the strategy.
* Build a network of contacts across government, political leadership, and public institutions to create sustained pathways for policy and institutional change.
* Spearhead coalition building with public institutions, political leadership, and civil society partners, in coordination with internal project streams, creating a high-leverage venue for catalytic action on political economy transitions.
* Lead the thinking on how policy, institutions, and narratives shape decision-making in food systems; scope and develop new ideas and programmes to shift this political economy towards sustainability transitions.

### **Research**

* Lead research and intelligence-gathering on the political economy of food systems reform, including the role of institutions, regulatory environments, incentives, and narratives in shaping decision-making.
* Develop intelligence and strategies to shape the political economy of food systems towards sustainability transitions, and identify levers and entry points for orchestrating change.
* Map stakeholders, interests, and power structures across government, political leadership, and public institutions relevant to food systems reform, ensuring alignment and collaborative execution.
* Lead research in the programme area as a principal investigator. Guide and provide relevant inputs to the wider research agenda.
* Assess and improve existing methodologies and frameworks employed by SFS relevant to political economy analysis, and build institutional capacity on such methodologies.
* Keep a tab on policy and political developments in agriculture and food systems.
* Strong writing skills with the ability to write coherently and concisely: emails, opinion pieces, policy briefs, and reports

### **Leadership and Mentoring**
