jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: R&D Executive — Product Development
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
Kaflur Foods develops and manufactures food products, under our own label and for other food brands. Every brief comes with a target: a shelf life to hold, a claim to meet, a taste that must be the same in batch forty as in batch one. We take it from brief to a specification production can hold. You will join a small development team and own briefs of your own from start to finish: running the trials and making the formulation calls. The work happens in our own development laboratory. You will take your formulations from the bench through scale-up, and you will be there when they do not behave at size, which is where the real learning in this field happens. The role is hands-on rather than supervisory, and deliberately broad. In a year you will work across several product categories and processes, and across formulation, costing, nutrition, labelling and sensory evaluation. A more narrowly drawn R&D function takes far longer to give anyone that range.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Translate briefs, our own and our clients', into formulations, and take them through bench trials to a specification production can hold
* Cost every formulation as you build it, so what you develop can be sold at a price that works
* Run scale-up trials with the production team, and solve what breaks between the bench and the line
* Compute nutrition and prepare FSSAI-compliant label copy for the products you develop
* Plan and run sensory evaluation, and read the panel honestly rather than for the answer you hoped for
* Keep formulation records, versions and trial data in order in our R&D system
* Work directly with clients on technical questions during development

What we're looking for
  
  

* M.Tech, M.Sc or B.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related discipline
* 1–3 years in product development or R&D within food manufacturing: FMCG, contract manufacturing or a food startup
* Hands-on bench experience: you have formulated something yourself and taken it through trials
* Working knowledge of FSSAI labelling and nutrition requirements
* An evidence-led habit: you reach for a measurement before an opinion
* Comfortable owning a brief from start to finish with support rather than supervision

Applications close on 31 December 2026.

jobs.description:
**Job Category:**
Quality
  
  
**Job Family:**
Quality Laboratory Services
  
  
**Job Description:**
The Lab Analyst – Plant supports site‑level quality and food safety objectives by performing analytical, microbiological, physical, and application testing in accordance with established laboratory procedures. This role partners closely with plant quality, operations, and food safety teams to ensure accurate testing, reliable data, and compliance with food safety and quality requirements.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Perform analytical, microbiological, physical, and application testing of raw materials, in‑process products, and finished goods following documented test methods and good laboratory practices.
* Support laboratory sample management activities, including receiving, logging, storing, and preparing samples for analysis.
* Review testing requests and coordinate daily workload with laboratory partners to meet production and quality timelines.
* Interpret, review, and verify laboratory data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with quality requirements.
* Prepare test reports, documentation, and records to support product release, investigations, and audits.
* Serve as a technical resource for plant quality and operations partners regarding laboratory results and testing methods.
* Evaluate laboratory processes, equipment, and procedures to support compliance and continuous improvement.
* Support laboratory investigations, including root cause analysis and corrective actions related to quality or food safety issues.
* Provide training and guidance to new laboratory partners and support field laboratory technical needs as required.
* Maintain laboratory safety, cleanliness, and organization in accordance with health, safety, and food safety policies.
* Support inventory management of laboratory supplies and reagents and place orders as needed.
* Support compliance with Food Safety and Food Quality Plans, including PCPs, CCPs, SOPs, and customer requirements.

What you will need to succeed
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific field (e.g., food science, microbiology, chemistry, biology).
* 3 to 5 years Laboratory experience in a food manufacturing, quality, or research environment preferred.
* Working knowledge of laboratory testing methods, good laboratory practices, and food safety principles.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a plant environment.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem‑solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic computer proficiency, including use of standard office software.
* Flexibility to work varied schedules, including weekends or extended hours, to support plant needs.

jobs.title: Operations Executive
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Process Study and Documentation**

* Study and map current operational processes across departments, from procurement and production planning through to dispatch and after-sales support.
* Collect and document process flows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and workflow diagrams.
* Identify gaps, bottlenecks, duplication, and non-value-added activities in existing processes.

**Plant Visits and On-Ground Observation**

* Visit manufacturing plants regularly to observe production, material handling, quality checks, and maintenance practices firsthand.
* Interact with plant supervisors, shift in-charges, and workers to understand daily challenges and practical constraints.
* Record observations, take process measurements (cycle times, throughput, downtime), and prepare visit reports with clear recommendations.

**Data Collection and Analysis**

* Gather operational data such as production output, yield, scrap rates, inventory levels, lead times, and on-time delivery.
* Analyze data using Excel and ERP reports to track KPIs and identify trends.
* Prepare dashboards and periodic MIS reports for management review.

**Operational Improvement**

* Propose and support improvement initiatives such as Lean, 5S, Kaizen, and waste reduction.
* Work with cross-functional teams (production, quality, supply chain, finance) to implement approved changes.
* Track the impact of improvements and report results against baseline metrics.

**Coordination and Support**

* Coordinate between corporate office and plant teams for planning, reviews, and issue resolution.
* Support budgeting, capacity planning, and cost analysis for operations.
* Assist in preparing presentations and documentation for senior management.

**Qualifications and Skills**

**Education**

* MBA in Operations, Operations & Supply Chain, or a related specialization from a recognized institution.

**Experience**

* Two years of experience in operations, production planning, process improvement, supply chain, or plant operations. Candidates with a strong internship background in a manufacturing setting will also be considered.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in MS Excel (pivot tables, lookups, dashboards) and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) is a strong advantage.
* Working knowledge of process mapping tools (flowcharts, SIPOC, value stream mapping).
* Understanding of Lean, Six Sigma (Yellow/Green Belt preferred), or Kaizen methodologies.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to write concise reports.
* Ability to work with plant floor teams and gain their trust and cooperation.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in data collection.
* Willingness to travel to plant locations as required, including occasional multi-day visits.

**Working Conditions**

* Primary base at the Hyderabad corporate office, with frequent travel to plant sites.
* Plant visits may involve standing and walking on production floors and adherence to safety protocols (PPE, safety induction).
* Some flexibility in hours may be required during plant trials, audits, or month-end reviews.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Completion and accuracy of process documentation within agreed timelines.
* Number of improvement opportunities identified and implemented.
* Measurable improvement in operational KPIs (productivity, yield, cost, lead time).
* Quality and timeliness of visit reports and MIS submissions.

Theobroma is looking for a curious, energetic and self-driven Market Research Intern to understand consumer preferences, food habits and the competitive bakery and dessert landscape in Hyderabad.

The role involves extensive fieldwork, interacting with consumers and visiting Theobroma stores and competitor outlets to identify opportunities for business growth.

* Conduct consumer interviews and surveys in and around Theobroma stores and competitor outlets.
* Understand consumer preferences, buying habits and occasions for cakes, desserts and snacks.

* Collect and analyse consumer insights and competitor data.

* Good analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides.

* Hands-on experience in consumer research and market analysis.
* Opportunity to work on a real business challenge for Theobroma.

**Important**

**This is a field-intensive role, not a desk-based internship.** Candidates must be comfortable travelling across Hyderabad, visiting stores and interacting with consumers on most working days.

2. Liaise effectively with customers to fulfill their regulatory documentation requirements and address inquiries.  
3. Collaborate with Quality Assurance to ensure all API manufacturing processes and documentation meet regulatory standards.  
4. Communicate regulatory updates and potential risks to senior management and relevant departments.  
5. Foster strong relationships with external regulatory consultants and partners as needed.  
6. Represent Synnat Pharma in industry forums and discussions related to API regulatory affairs.  
   
Regulatory Compliance & Strategy  
1. Monitor and interpret new and evolving regulatory guidelines, including FDA and EMA regulations, to ensure continuous compliance.  
2. Assess the impact of regulatory changes on Synnat Pharma's API products and operations.  
3. Develop and implement regulatory strategies for new product registrations and market expansions.  
4. Provide expert regulatory guidance to internal teams, including R&D, Quality Assurance, and Manufacturing.  
5. Conduct regular internal audits and reviews to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal SOPs.  
6. Participate in cross-functional teams to address regulatory challenges and streamline processes.  
   
Quality Systems & Data Management  
1. Maintain organized and accessible electronic and physical archives of all regulatory documents.  
2. Ensure data integrity and accuracy in all regulatory submissions and internal records.  
3. Support the implementation and maintenance of electronic document management systems (EDMS) for regulatory affairs.  
4. Prepare detailed reports on regulatory submission status, approvals, and compliance metrics.  
5. Contribute to the continuous improvement of regulatory affairs processes and procedures.  
6. Train junior staff on regulatory documentation practices and compliance requirements.  
   
Regulatory Documentation & Submissions  
1. Prepare, compile, and maintain comprehensive regulatory documentation for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) in accordance with ICH Guidelines.  
2. Support the preparation and submission of Drug Master Files (DMFs) for various health authorities, including FDA and EMA.  
3. Manage and update existing regulatory submissions, ensuring timely amendments and renewals.  
4. Coordinate and prepare responses to health authority queries and customer requests related to regulatory filings.  
5. Ensure all regulatory documents comply with Common Technical Document (CTD) and electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) formats.  
6. Oversee the lifecycle management of regulatory documents from initial submission through approval and maintenance.

Job Title: Quality Analyst – Food, Dairy & Sweets Manufacturing

**Company:** Bikanervala  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Department:** Quality Assurance / Quality Control  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Industry:** Food Processing, Dairy Products, Sweets & Confectionery

Job Summary

Bikanervala is looking for a dedicated and experienced Quality Analyst with practical knowledge of food quality control, dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety, hygiene, process control and regulatory compliance across food production and processing operations.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in dairy products, khoya/mawa, paneer, ghee, milk-based sweets and traditional Indian sweets, along with knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000 standards.

Key Responsibilities1. Raw Material Quality Inspection

* Inspect incoming raw materials such as milk, cream, khoya, paneer, ghee, sugar, flour, besan, dry fruits, edible oils and other food ingredients.
* Check raw material quality, freshness, specifications and supplier COAs.
* Conduct physical, chemical and sensory inspections.
* Monitor milk quality parameters, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Identify and segregate rejected or non-conforming raw materials.
* Maintain incoming material inspection records.

2. In-Process Quality Control – Dairy Products

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of milk, paneer, curd, yoghurt, ghee, butter, khoa and other dairy products.
* Monitor pasteurisation temperature and holding time.
* Check milk fat, SNF, acidity, pH and moisture.
* Monitor coagulation, fermentation, cooling and processing parameters.
* Ensure product consistency, texture, colour and taste.
* Monitor chilling, cold storage and hygienic handling practices.

3. In-Process Quality Control – Indian Sweets

* Monitor quality during the manufacturing of Rasgulla, Rasmalai, Gulab Jamun, Kaju Katli, Barfi, Peda, Kalakand, Milk Cake, Besan Laddu, Motichoor Laddu and other traditional sweets.
* Monitor sugar syrup concentration using a refractometer (Brix).
* Check cooking temperature and processing time.
* Monitor moisture, texture, colour, taste and consistency.
* Check frying temperature and frying oil quality.
* Ensure uniformity in product size, weight, shape and appearance.
* Monitor cooling, handling and storage conditions.

4. Finished Product Quality Inspection

* Conduct final quality inspections before product release.
* Perform sensory evaluation for appearance, colour, taste, aroma and texture.
* Check product weight, moisture, pH, acidity, fat and Brix wherever applicable.
* Verify packaging quality, sealing and product labelling.
* Monitor batch number, manufacturing date and expiry date.
* Coordinate microbiological testing.
* Ensure finished products meet approved quality specifications.

5. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations and applicable food safety requirements.
* Monitor personal hygiene and food handling practices of production employees.
* Conduct regular production-floor hygiene inspections.
* Ensure proper cleaning and sanitation of equipment, utensils, processing areas and machinery.
* Monitor pest control, waste disposal and water quality.
* Prevent cross-contamination and allergen contamination.
* Verify cleaning and sanitation records.

6. Food Safety Management Systems

* Implement and monitor HACCP-based food safety systems.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GHP and SSOP.
* Support implementation and maintenance of ISO 22000 standards.
* Identify potential biological, chemical and physical hazards.
* Monitor Critical Control Points (CCPs) and applicable OPRPs.
* Maintain food safety monitoring and verification records.
* Ensure calibration of laboratory and quality inspection instruments.

7. Laboratory Testing & Analysis

* Perform routine physical and chemical testing of raw materials and finished products.
* Conduct milk testing for fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Perform moisture, pH, acidity and Brix analysis.
* Monitor frying oil quality and deterioration.
* Coordinate microbiological testing, including total plate count, yeast and mould, coliforms and other applicable parameters.
* Maintain laboratory records and test reports.
* Coordinate external laboratory testing when required.

8. Quality Audits & Documentation

* Conduct daily quality inspections and internal hygiene audits.
* Identify non-conformities and process deviations.
* Perform root cause analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone techniques.
* Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Maintain raw material inspection reports, production quality records, CCP monitoring sheets, laboratory reports, cleaning records and audit documentation.
* Support internal, external, FSSAI and customer audits.
* Maintain product traceability and recall-related records.

9. Coordination with Production & Operations

* Coordinate with production teams to maintain consistent product quality.
* Identify and resolve quality issues during manufacturing.
* Communicate deviations and recommend corrective measures.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse and operations teams.
* Monitor customer complaints, product rejections and quality improvement activities.
* Conduct food safety and hygiene awareness training for production employees.

Required Skills & Technical Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations and food safety standards.
* Practical knowledge of dairy processing and Indian sweets manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience in HACCP, GMP, GHP, SSOP and ISO 22000.
* Knowledge of milk testing, including fat, SNF, acidity and adulteration.
* Knowledge of khoya/mawa quality testing and moisture analysis.
* Experience in Brix testing using a refractometer.
* Knowledge of frying oil quality monitoring.
* Understanding of microbiological testing and shelf-life evaluation.
* Knowledge of CAPA, root cause analysis and internal quality audits.
* Good analytical, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Strong documentation and reporting abilities.

Important Practical Skills Required

Candidates with hands-on experience in the following areas will be preferred:

* Milk quality testing and dairy product analysis.
* Khoya/Mawa quality inspection.
* Sugar syrup concentration testing (Brix).
* Moisture analysis of sweets and dairy products.
* Frying oil quality monitoring.
* Microbiological testing and hygiene monitoring.
* Shelf-life evaluation of dairy products and Indian sweets.
* Finished product sensory evaluation.
* Production-floor quality monitoring and batch inspection.
* Educational Qualification
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology.

Experience Required

* 1–5 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control.
* Experience in dairy, sweets, confectionery or food processing manufacturing will be preferred.

jobs.description:
Food Safety & Production Supervisor

**Company:** Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream Pvt Ltd **Location:** Velachery Central Kitchen, Chennai **Reports to:** Head of Operations **Type:** Full-time, on-site (factory-based, with periodic store visits) **Apply to:** jobs@amadora.in

About Amadora

Amadora makes premium artisanal ice cream, baked goods, sauces, bars and cakes from scratch — no premixes, no compounds. Everything is produced at our central kitchen in Chennai on Pastomaster and Carpigiani equipment and distributed to franchise and company-owned stores across Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. As we scale, the discipline of the factory floor is what protects the brand.

The Role

We are looking for a food technologist who has worked as a Food Safety Executive and is ready to own both sides of the floor: making sure production runs the way the process says it should, and making sure food safety norms are followed without exception, every single day.

This is a hands-on shop-floor role, not a desk role. You will be present during production, checking that steps are followed as written, catching deviations while they are still small, and holding the line on hygiene, traceability and equipment condition. Alongside the daily work, you will drive our ISO certification programme and partner with the Training team to take food safety standards out to the stores.

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily production supervision

* Verify that every batch is produced to the approved recipe, sequence, temperature and time parameters — pasteurisation, ageing, batch freezing, blast freezing, hardening and packing.
* Run and sign off start-of-shift, in-process and end-of-shift checks; ensure line clearance between batches and between allergen and non-allergen runs.
* Check equipment and tooling condition before use — moulds, scoops, containers, gaskets, blades — and enforce immediate quarantine and physical removal of any damaged, chipped or worn item from the production area.
* Monitor CCPs and record readings in real time; escalate deviations immediately rather than at end of day.
* Verify raw material and packaging at receipt (COA, temperature, condition, shelf life) and enforce FEFO in cold rooms and dry stores.
* Support the production plan — yields, batch sizing, changeover time, wastage — and flag where process adherence and output targets are in conflict.

2. Food safety and hygiene compliance

* Own day-to-day implementation of HACCP, GMP and GHP across the facility.
* Manage personal hygiene, health checks, gowning and handwashing compliance for all production staff.
* Schedule and verify cleaning and sanitation (CIP and manual), pest control, water testing, swab testing and calibration; maintain the records.
* Run the foreign-material control programme: metal, glass, hard plastic, wood and mould-fragment controls, with defined inspection and breakage procedures.
* Manage the finished-goods and shelf-life testing programme, micro sampling and third-party lab coordination.
* Maintain FSSAI licence conditions and Schedule 4 compliance; be the point person for FSSAI and customer audits.
* Investigate customer complaints and internal non-conformances to root cause, define CAPA, and verify that the corrective action actually holds a month later.
* Maintain full batch traceability and be able to run a mock recall to closure.

3. ISO / FSSC certification

* Lead preparation for ISO 22000:2018 (and FSSC 22000 where applicable) — gap assessment, documentation, PRPs, HACCP plan, internal audits, management review and closure of certification body findings.
* Build and maintain the food safety management system documentation: manual, procedures, formats, records.
* Train and hand-hold the production team through the changes the certification requires, so the system survives after the certificate is issued.

4. Store food safety, with the Training team

* Work with the Head of Training to convert factory food safety standards into simple, teachable store-level procedures — cold chain, thawing, display, scooping hygiene, cleaning schedules, expiry management, allergen handling.
* Co-create training content, checklists and audit formats for franchise and company-owned stores.
* Conduct periodic store food safety audits, score them, and drive closure of findings with the operations and training teams.
* Support franchisee-side FSSAI compliance and readiness for regulatory inspections.

5. Documentation and reporting

* Maintain daily, weekly and monthly food safety and production compliance dashboards.
* Report non-conformances, wastage, complaint trends and audit scores to management with clear cause and action.

Qualifications and Competencies

**Required**

* B.Tech / M.Tech / B.Sc / M.Sc in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or a related discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience, including a proven stint as a Food Safety Executive or Officer in a food manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of HACCP, GMP, GHP, FSSAI regulations and Schedule 4.
* Experience preparing for or maintaining ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 certification.
* Comfortable with documentation and record discipline — you can build a format, and you can also make people fill it correctly.
* Physically comfortable working in a cold-chain environment, including chillers and blast freezers, and around early production shifts.

**Preferred**

* Dairy, frozen dessert, bakery or chocolate manufacturing background.
* Certified HACCP Level 3 / ISO 22000 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor.
* Multi-site or retail-outlet audit exposure.
* Working Tamil and English; Kannada or Telugu a bonus given our other markets.

**Competencies we care about**

* Willingness to stop a batch. The right answer is sometimes expensive, and we want someone who says it anyway.
* Firm without being adversarial — you will be enforcing standards on colleagues you work beside every day.
* Bias for root cause over blame; interest in why the process allowed the mistake, not just who made it.
* Attention to detail that holds up on day 200, not just day 20.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

* **Month 1–3:** You have mapped every production line end to end, documented the actual process against the written SOP, and produced a prioritised gap list covering process adherence, hygiene, equipment condition and record-keeping.
* **Month 3–4:** Daily production and food safety checks are running consistently across all shifts, with real-time recording and same-day escalation of deviations — verified by you, not self-reported.
* **Month 6:** The ISO 22000 documentation set is complete, PRPs and the HACCP plan are implemented, and the first full internal audit cycle has been completed with CAPAs closed.
* **Month 6–9:** A store food safety standard, training module and audit checklist are live with the Training team, and the first round of audits is complete across Chennai stores.
* **Month 9–12:** ISO certification audit cleared, with no major non-conformances outstanding.
* **Through the year:** A measurable fall in food-safety-related customer complaints and internal non-conformances, with a traceability and mock-recall capability that closes within the target window.

Why Amadora

You will be the person who owns food safety at a brand that makes everything from scratch — which means real process, real risk and real ownership, not a premix line where the standards were set by someone else. You will build the system, certify it, and take it out to every store. Direct access to the founder and the leadership team, and a company growing fast enough that what you build now becomes how it operates at three times the size.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

**Job Title:**Assistant QA Manager – Food Safety & Quality Systems

**Company:** CTB Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Job Type:** Full-time, On-site  
**Salary:** ₹50,000–₹60,000 gross per month, plus employer PF and annual performance bonus as per company policy.

About the Company

CTB Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. is a growing B2B bakery manufacturer supplying burger buns, breads, pitas, pizza bases and specialty bakery products to restaurants, cafés, QSRs and cloud kitchens.

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, hands-on QA professional to **take ownership of our quality assurance and food safety function**.

This is a leadership role requiring someone who can independently assess existing practices, establish effective quality systems, implement improvements and ensure consistent standards throughout our manufacturing operations.

**We are looking for a person who takes initiative, solves problems and drives results—not someone who simply conducts inspections or maintains records.**

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead and develop the QA/QC function**, establishing effective quality systems, SOPs, inspection procedures and operational controls.
* **Ensure product quality and process compliance** throughout manufacturing, from incoming materials and ingredient preparation to production, packaging and finished goods.
* **Own food safety and regulatory compliance**, including FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, sanitation, hygiene, audits and required documentation.
* **Establish and maintain traceability, quality records and product release controls**, ensuring audit readiness and effective management of nonconformities.
* **Investigate quality issues and customer complaints**, identify root causes, implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and prevent recurrence.
* **Lead and guide QA personnel**, train production teams and work closely with other departments to ensure quality standards are consistently followed.
* **Drive continuous improvement**, proactively identifying weaknesses, implementing practical solutions and monitoring measurable results.
* Report quality performance and critical risks directly to management, taking responsibility for follow-up and resolution.

Candidate Requirements

* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology or a related discipline.
* Minimum **5 years of QA/QC experience in food manufacturing**; bakery experience preferred.
* Strong practical knowledge of FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, quality documentation and audits.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or improving QA systems, SOPs, process controls and CAPA.
* Ability to independently manage QA activities, guide staff and coordinate effectively with production teams.
* Strong organizational, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Hands-on approach, high personal accountability and the ability to follow through without constant supervision.

**Preference will be given to candidates who have personally established, implemented or substantially improved quality systems in a food manufacturing facility.**

What We Offer

An opportunity to lead and develop the quality function of a growing food manufacturing company, with significant autonomy, direct interaction with management and the ability to make a measurable impact.

**Work Schedule:** Primarily daytime hours, with flexibility for occasional night-time production visits as required. This is not a permanent night-shift position.

jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

This position involves developing innovative food and beverage products with a specific focus on food formulation and microencapsulation technologies. The role includes developing and optimising food formulations, working with microencapsulated ingredients, evaluating encapsulation techniques, and improving ingredient stability, functionality, solubility, dispersibility and controlled release properties in food applications.

The candidate will be responsible for executing laboratory-scale trials, ingredient selection, formulation optimisation, product testing and supporting the scale-up and commercialisation of new products. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate innovative ingredient technologies into commercially viable food products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, optimise and validate food and beverage formulations based on product requirements and application needs.
* Work on microencapsulation of functional food ingredients, including flavours, colours, vitamins, minerals, oils, probiotics and other bioactive ingredients.
* Explore and work with microencapsulation techniques such as spray drying, coacervation, emulsification and other relevant encapsulation technologies.
* Identify and evaluate suitable core materials, wall materials, carriers and encapsulating agents for different food applications.
* Conduct laboratory-scale experiments and optimise formulation and process parameters to improve encapsulation efficiency, stability and product performance.
* Evaluate the physicochemical properties of encapsulated ingredients, including particle size, moisture content, solubility, dispersibility, encapsulation efficiency and stability, wherever applicable.
* Incorporate microencapsulated ingredients into different food matrices and evaluate their functionality, compatibility and performance.
* Conduct ingredient calculations, proximate analysis, sensory evaluation and shelf-life studies.
* Evaluate and select suitable wall materials and carrier materials based on ingredient compatibility, encapsulation efficiency, stability and intended food application.
* Develop and optimise formulations based on food safety, regulatory requirements, quality standards and commercial feasibility.
* Coordinate with R&D, quality, production and other cross-functional teams for product trials, process optimisation and scale-up.
* Maintain experimental records, prepare technical reports and document product development activities.
* Stay updated on emerging encapsulation technologies, functional ingredients and innovations in food science.

**Qualifications:**  
Master’s or Ph.D. in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, Culinary Arts, or related field

**Responsibility and Decision-Making Authority:**  
Empowered to make project and cross-functional decisions in partnership with peers.

**Experience:**  
Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in food product development, food formulation or applied food science R&D, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience in microencapsulation technology, encapsulated ingredient development or application of microencapsulated ingredients in food formulations.

Hands-on experience in spray drying, coacervation, emulsion-based encapsulation or application of microencapsulated ingredients in food products will be preferred.

**Travel:**  
Ability to travel as required

Bio 360 Lifesciences Park, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala

As per industry. Will consider higher for deserving candidates

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Position: Mechanical Engineering Manager (NPI/NPD)**

  

**Work Location: Hyderabad**

**Industry: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)**

  

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated NPI Mechanical Engineering Manager to lead the industrialization, assembly excellence, reliability engineering, and manufacturing readiness of aerospace-grade motor assemblies and electro-mechanical systems. This is a critical leadership role responsible for driving New Product Introduction (NPI) programs from design transfer through production ramp-up while ensuring compliance with aerospace quality, reliability, and regulatory standards.

  

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in precision motor assembly, electro-mechanical system integration, aerospace manufacturing, tooling development, quality systems, supplier development, and cross-functional team leadership. The role requires a hands-on engineering leader capable of solving complex technical challenges, driving operational excellence, and supporting customers and suppliers throughout the product lifecycle.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**1. Electro mechanical Assembly Expertise**

* Lead manufacturing and assembly of high-precision aerospace motors including:

+ BLDC / AC / DC motors
+ Servo motors / actuators
+ High-speed rotating systems

* Deep understanding of:

+ Rotor-stator assembly alignment
+ Dynamic balancing (G-level accuracy)
+ Bearing selection, preload, lubrication techniques
+ Winding processes, insulation systems, varnishing

* Address critical parameters:

+ Runout, concentricity, vibration limits
+ Thermal expansion & heat dissipation
+ Noise and performance stability

* Ensure compliance with aerospace tolerances and traceability requirements

**2. Electro-Mechanical Systems Integration**

* Manage full assembly lifecycle of electro-mechanical products, including:

+ Motors + Controllers + Harnessing + Sensors

* Integration challenges:

+ EMI/EMC considerations
+ Thermal and structural interactions
+ Precision fitment of mechanical + electrical interfaces

* Validate system-level performance under:

+ Vibration, shock, thermal cycling
+ Endurance / life-cycle testing

**3. Advanced NPI & Industrialization**

* Lead end-to-end aerospace NPI programs:

+ Design transfer Proto EVT / DVT / PVT Mass production

* Drive:

+ DFM / DFA optimization
+ Manufacturing readiness reviews (MRR)
+ Risk mitigation plans (DFMEA / PFMEA)

* Establish:

+ Process flow diagrams, control plans, work instructions

* Ensure readiness for:

+ AS9100 audit compliance
+ First-time-right production

**4. Engineering Drawings & CAD Mastery**

* Expert-level capability in CAD drawing reading and interpretation:

+ GD&T (ASME Y14.5 standard preferred)
+ Tolerance stack-up analysis
+ Critical-to-function feature identification

* Ability to:

+ Identify manufacturability risks directly from drawings
+ Suggest design corrections for assembly feasibility

* Work with tools:

+ Creo / NX / SolidWorks

* Drive engineering change management (ECR/ECO)

**5. Tools, Jigs & Fixture Development (Critical Skill Area)**

* Design and validate:

+ Assembly fixtures (alignment, press-fit tools)
+ Coil winding fixtures
+ Rotor balancing setups

* Knowledge of:

+ Pneumatic / hydraulic tools
+ Torque control systems
+ Automated assembly stations

* Focus on:

+ Error-proofing (poka-yoke)
+ Repeatability & precision
+ Cycle time reduction

**6. FAIR, Quality & Aerospace Compliance**

* Lead FAIR (First Article Inspection Report) execution as per AS9102
* Strong exposure to:

+ AS9100, NADCAP (preferred)

* Drive:

+ APQP, PPAP (adapted for aerospace)
+ Control of special processes

* Perform:

+ Root cause analysis (8D, Fishbone, 5 Why)
+ Failure investigations (fractography, wear analysis, misalignment)

**7. Supplier Development & Field Problem Resolution**

* Extensive travel to supplier and customer locations for:

+ Process audits
+ Technical issue resolution
+ Qualification activities

* Manage:

+ Supplier capability assessments
+ Critical component validation (laminations, bearings, shafts)

* Act as technical leader in:

+ Customer escalations
+ On-site troubleshooting of assembly failures

**8. Team Leadership & Execution Excellence**

* Lead cross-functional teams:

+ Mechanical / Manufacturing / Quality engineers

* Drive:

+ Performance management
+ Capability building (technical mentoring)

* Establish:

+ Strong engineering governance
+ Structured problem-solving culture

  

**Required Qualifications**

* B.E / B.Tech / M.E in Mechanical Engineering

  

* 15 to 20 years in:

+ Aerospace / defense / high-reliability EMS
+ Motor assembly and electro-mechanical systems
+ NPI and manufacturing engineering

  

**Critical Technical Competencies**

* Aerospace motor assembly fundamentals
* GD&T mastery & tolerance stack analysis
* FAIR (AS9102), APQP, PPAP
* Fixture/tooling design and validation
* Failure analysis & reliability engineering
* Supplier development and audits
* Lean manufacturing & Six Sigma

**Company:** Bombay Kulfi Ice Creams Private Limited  
**Location:** Mumbai  
**Work Mode:** Field-based – Regular travel required  
**Experience:** 4–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive, responsible and people-oriented Relationship Manager to act as the primary point of contact between Bombay Kulfi Ice Creams and its franchise partners.

The role involves managing franchise relationships, regularly visiting assigned outlets, understanding business and operational challenges, coordinating with internal departments and driving sales growth across assigned stores.

The candidate will be based in Mumbai and will be required to travel regularly to franchise outlets in Eastern Part of India

Key Responsibilities

* Act as the single point of contact for assigned franchise outlets.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with franchise partners.
* Regularly visit assigned outlets to understand operational challenges and business requirements.
* Monitor store sales and identify opportunities to improve revenue and profitability.
* Coordinate with internal departments to resolve franchisee requirements.
* Ensure timely execution of marketing campaigns, product launches, seasonal activities and visual merchandising.
* Monitor operational standards, customer experience and brand compliance.
* Identify underperforming outlets and work with franchise partners to implement improvement plans.
* Drive sales growth through regular engagement, follow-ups and business initiatives.
* Handle franchisee escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain outlet-wise performance reports and follow-up records.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum 4–5 years of experience in Relationship Management, Sales, Retail Operations, Client Servicing or Franchise Management.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in English and Hindi is mandatory.
* Strong negotiation, coordination and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple franchise partners and outlets simultaneously.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word and Google Workspace.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Willingness to travel extensively within assigned territories.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in FMCG, QSR, Food & Beverage, Retail or Franchise Operations.
* Experience in handling multiple retail outlets or business partners.
* Candidates with sales and business development experience will be preferred.

Compensation & Incentives

* Attractive salary based on experience and capabilities.
* Additional sales incentives based on performance and achievement of targets.
* Opportunity to grow with an expanding retail and franchise brand.

**Location:** Mumbai  
**Travel:** Regular travel to franchise outlets is mandatory.

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed or send their updated resume to manish@bombaykulfi.com.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Mumbai District, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Experience in Food Industry Sales and Marketing to HORECA.

Experience:

* B2B sales: 5 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION  
Field Sales Representative (FSR)

**Company:** Schwifty Foods & Beverages Pvt. Ltd.  
**Brand:** DUDE – Juice with Nata de Coco  
**Department:** Sales & Distribution  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Field Sales  
**Reporting To:** Area Sales Manager (ASM) / Regional Sales Manager (RSM)  
**Location:** As per assigned territory

About the Company

Schwifty Foods & Beverages Pvt. Ltd. is a growing FMCG beverage company offering innovative, youth-focused beverages under its flagship brand, **DUDE – Juice with Nata de Coco**.

We are looking for energetic, target-driven Field Sales Representatives to expand our retail distribution network, acquire new outlets, strengthen distributor relationships, and drive consistent sales growth across assigned territories.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Retail Market Visits & Outlet Acquisition**

* Conduct daily market visits to retail shops, grocery stores, supermarkets, convenience stores, and beverage outlets.
* Identify and onboard new retail outlets within the assigned territory.
* Pitch DUDE products to shopkeepers, communicate product benefits, and convince them to purchase and stock the products.
* Generate orders from new and existing retail outlets.
* Ensure effective product placement, shelf visibility, and availability at retail counters and refrigerators.
* Build strong relationships with retailers to encourage repeat orders and long-term business.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with retailers to monitor sales movement and prevent stockouts.

**2. Institutional Sales – College & School Canteens**

* Identify and approach college canteens, school canteens, coaching institutes, and other educational institutions.
* Meet canteen owners, contractors, and purchase decision-makers to introduce DUDE beverages.
* Negotiate commercial terms and secure product listings and initial orders.
* Coordinate product sampling and promotional activities wherever required.
* Ensure consistent product availability and regular replenishment at onboarded institutions.
* Develop long-term relationships with canteen operators to increase repeat sales and product penetration.

**3. Distributor Management & Sales Coordination**

* Coordinate regularly with assigned distributors to ensure smooth product supply and market coverage.
* Monitor distributor stock-in (incoming inventory) and stock-out (outgoing inventory) movements.
* Ensure sufficient stock availability across all DUDE SKUs and prevent stock shortages.
* Support achievement of **primary sales targets** (company-to-distributor billing).
* Drive **secondary sales targets** (distributor-to-retailer/institution billing).
* Coordinate with distributors for timely order processing, dispatches, and deliveries.
* Track slow-moving inventory and proactively recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor distributor performance, stock rotation, and sales movement.

**4. Sales Target Achievement & Market Expansion**

* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Increase the number of active retail outlets and institutional accounts within the territory.
* Maximize product availability, visibility, and sales volume across all assigned outlets.
* Generate repeat business through consistent retailer engagement and order follow-ups.
* Identify untapped markets and potential sales opportunities.
* Execute company sales schemes, promotional offers, and market activation initiatives.

**5. Merchandising & Brand Visibility**

* Ensure proper display and positioning of DUDE beverages at retail outlets.
* Place promotional materials such as posters, danglers, shelf strips, and other POSM.
* Encourage retailers to provide prominent shelf and refrigerator placement.
* Conduct regular visibility checks and ensure merchandising standards are maintained.
* Support in-store sampling and promotional campaigns to improve product awareness and consumer trials.

**6. Market Intelligence & Daily Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of daily market visits, new outlet onboarding, orders, and sales achievements.
* Submit Daily Sales Reports (DSR) to the reporting manager.
* Track retailer feedback, competitor pricing, trade schemes, and market activities.
* Report distributor stock levels, primary sales, secondary sales, and pending orders.
* Identify and report operational challenges affecting sales or product availability.
* Share market insights and improvement recommendations with management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on the following parameters:

KPIPerformance MeasureRetail Market CoverageDaily productive outlet visitsNew Retailer AcquisitionNew outlets onboardedInstitutional AcquisitionNew college/school canteens onboardedPrimary SalesDistributor billing against targetSecondary SalesDistributor-to-market sales against targetProduct PlacementNumber of outlets with active product availabilityRepeat OrdersActive outlets generating repeat purchasesDistributor Stock ManagementStock availability and replenishmentMerchandisingProduct visibility and POSM executionReportingTimely and accurate daily sales reportingEligibility & Requirements

* Minimum qualification: 12th Pass / Graduate preferred.
* Previous experience in FMCG, beverages, food products, or general trade sales is preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication and selling skills may also apply.
* Good understanding of local retail markets and distributor operations.
* Strong negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building abilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
* Ability to work independently and achieve assigned sales targets.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
* Basic smartphone proficiency for order reporting and sales tracking.

Skills & Competencies

* Retail Sales & Market Development
* Distributor & Channel Management
* Product Pitching & Negotiation
* Institutional Account Acquisition
* Primary & Secondary Sales Execution
* Merchandising & Product Placement
* Customer Relationship Management
* Target Orientation & Field Discipline

Compensation & Benefits

* Fixed Salary: As per experience and company standards.
* Performance-Based Sales Incentives.
* Travel Allowance: As per company policy.
* Growth opportunities within the sales organization.

Role Objective

**To maximize DUDE's market penetration by acquiring new retail and institutional customers, ensuring strong product placement, maintaining distributor stock availability, and consistently achieving primary and secondary sales targets.**

**Schwifty Foods & Beverages Pvt. Ltd.**

**Salary Structure - Rs 22000 monthly Fixed + Rs 300 TA/DA**  
*DUDE – Juice with Nata de Coco*  
www.dudebevs.com

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹22,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
The **Sales Manager – West India** will be responsible for **identifying new business opportunities, managing key customer relationships, and achieving sales targets for FMS products** . This role requires a deep understanding of industrial equipment sales, excellent relationship management skills, and the ability to work independently in a competitive market.

The Sales Manager will play a key role in positioning NOV’s **locally manufactured agitators and globally sourced progressive cavity pumps** as preferred solutions for customers, contributing to the company’s revenue growth and market expansion.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Sales & Business Development**

* Develop and execute a **strategic sales plan** to grow the FMS business in West India.
* Identify and engage **new customers, EPC contractors, and OEMs** in target industries.
* Promote **locally manufactured agitators** and **imported progressive cavity pumps** as competitive solutions.
* Drive **technical sales discussions, product demonstrations, and solution-based selling** to meet customer needs.
* Ensure achievement of **annual sales targets** .

**2. Market Expansion & Competitive Positioning**

* Conduct detailed **market analysis** to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive threats.
* Monitor competitor activities and develop strategies to differentiate NOV’s offerings.
* Develop and maintain a **robust sales pipeline** with a clear focus on high-potential accounts.

**3. Customer Engagement & Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with **decisionmakers, plant managers, and procurement teams** in key industries.
* Conduct **customer visits, technical presentations, and training sessions** to enhance engagement.
* Work closely with the **applications and engineering teams** to provide customized solutions.

**4. Sales Process Management & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate sales data in **CRM systems** , ensuring **proper tracking of leads, quotes, and orders** .
* Provide **weekly and monthly sales reports** , including forecasts and key customer insights.
* Ensure **timely follow-up on proposals and negotiations** to drive deal closures.

**5. Collaboration with Internal Teams**

* Work closely with **the manufacturing facility in Navi Mumbai** to align on production capabilities and delivery timelines.
* Collaborate with **the service and aftermarket teams** to drive long-term customer retention and recurring revenue.
* Coordinate with **regional and global sales teams** to align business strategies.

  

**Education & Experience:**

* **Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, or related field).** MBA is a plus.
* **5+ years of experience** in **technical sales, business development, or key account management** within the industrial equipment sector.
* Prior experience in selling **agitators, pumps, or fluid-handling solutions** is preferred.
* Strong network in **pharma, chemicals, food & beverage, petrochemicals, and water treatment industries** .

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* **Proven sales track record** in meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Strong **negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills** .
* Technical understanding of **fluid-handling systems and process equipment** .
* Ability to work independently and **manage a large geographic territory** .
* Proficiency in **CRM tools for** sales tracking and reporting.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Rajasthan, and Madhya Pradesh etc..

jobs.description:
No Relocation Assistance Offered
  
  
Job Number #177295 - Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
  
  
**Who We Are**
Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
  
  
Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
  
  
**What are we looking for:**
We are looking for smart, dynamic trainees who will work in our India Global technology center (GTC) based in Mumbai. It will be a learning & growth opportunity to plan & implement initiatives in partnership with an ambitious Microbiology team. This team works on strong partnerships with respective categories for India GTC while being compliant to defined safety, quality & regulatory norms. The tenure for a trainee is proposed to 2 years from the date of joining.
  
  
**What You’ll Need**

* M.Sc in Microbiology with strong fundamental knowledge in Microbiology
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Suite proficiency (i.e, Sheets, Slides, Docs)

**What you will do**
:
  
  

* Perform Microbiology analysis for finished products, raw materials and WIP samples as CP standards and guidelines
* Conducting environment monitoring, water testing and cleaning & sanitization checks for Pilot plant equipment to ensure GMP conditions are maintained as per Colgate requirements..
* Execute tests to support claims for regional products
* Ensure maintenance of lab equipments
* Contribute in sample management and lab inventory
* Participate in lab investigations and provide valuable inputs in root cause analysis and action points.

**What you will learn**
:
  
  

* Core expertise on Microbiology methodologies and best industry practices.
* Functional Linkages - you will get an overview of how different departments are integrated into overall R&D eg: Product development team and Microbiology team
* Operational Excellence - Build on technical expertise, expanding it in complementary directions. Use technical expertise and creativity to proactively identify potential problems and address them using appropriate resources in discussion with team leaders. You will also learn to integrate yourself into a high-performing team focused on balancing both execution and innovation.
* You will be coached for success on technical as well as soft skills. We will evaluate your progress periodically and ensure scheduled training sessions for your continued success during your traineeship at Colgate.
* Quality and Safety principles: At Colgate we strive for excellence in everything we do. These principles are not only important for our trusted brands but also to our workplaces. You will be exposed to specific training on Q & S, to assure your trust while working in a safe environment where quality is paramount.

**Our Commitment to Inclusion**
Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Technical Expert MS&T
jobs.description:
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Support to Internal Sites and CMOs Act as Technical Expert for assigned internal manufacturing sites or CMOs, ensuring process capability and maintaining products in a validated state.
* Apply science- and risk-based approaches to ensure sustainable product quality.
* Ensure availability of all relevant technical documentation (protocols, reports, risk assessments, concept papers, scientific justifications) ahead of planned site activities.

**Product & Technical Stewardship**

* Maintain oversight and deep understanding of the entire manufacturing process across the product lifecycle.
* Identify and monitor CQAs, CMAs, and CPPs to ensure process robustness and product quality.
* Analyze manufacturing data (OPV, CPV, APQR) to assess state of control and recommend improvements.
* Evaluate technical changes, assess feasibility, and define scope/design of technical batches.
* Contribute to registration strategy and align regulatory timelines for changes, transfers, launches, and deviations.
* Lead/support root cause investigations for product/process failures and drive remediation/improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Quality, Operations, Engineering, and Development teams.
* Share best practices and lessons learned across divisions and sites.

**Validation Support**

* Define and implement validation strategies and supporting documentation.
* Maintain validation oversight and ensure products remain in a validated state.
* Review QRAs and challenge control strategies based on CQAs, CPPs, and CMAs.
* Ensure technical batches generate sufficient process knowledge.
* Support creation and review of validation protocols and reports.
* Contribute to revalidation planning and documentation.

**Launch & Transfer Support**

* Participate in supplier/product evaluation and selection processes.
* Gather and document technical information on manufacturing capabilities of sites/CMOs.
* Provide data and documentation for tech transfer activities, leveraging existing process knowledge.
* Define product acceptance criteria and monitor performance post-transfer.
* Ensure successful, well-documented product transfers and launches.
* Actively support governance processes for product launch and transfer.

**Interface with Development**

* Ensure new products and processes are designed for commercial scalability and lifecycle sustainability.
* Provide input at formal stage gates during development and up to first OPV/APQR.
* Support development of control strategies that meet regulatory and operational requirements.

**Manufacturing & Operational Excellence**

* Lead design and control optimization projects to improve process robustness and sustainability.
* Provide SME-level expertise for process characterization of biologics manufacturing.
* Prepare high-quality design and operational documents.
* Proactively take on challenging projects driven by evolving regulatory requirements, audits, and compliance needs.

**Training**

* Own and maintain the training curriculum relevant to the job description and responsibilities.

**Minimum Requirements**
**What you'll bring to the role:**
**Ideal Background**
**Education (minimum/desirable)**

* Experience in biologics manufacturing including cell culture, fermentation, purification, and formulation processes
* Post Graduate in Pharmacy/Biology/Bio tech/Relevant Life Sciences/ Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Technology (preferred)

**Languages**

* Fluent in English & Languages in the Region

**Relevant Experiences**

* 8-12 years of relevant experience in manufacturing. Additional specialist experience is preferred
* Strong knowledge of regulatory guidelines: USFDA, EMA, ICH, ASTM, SUPAC.
* Expertise in QbD, DoE, Minitab, and statistical analysis.
* Ability to prepare high-quality design and operational documents for equipment qualification, verification, and continuous process validation.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects in a global matrix environment.

**You'll Receive**
Breakdown of benefits received in this role. Include flexible working, learning and development opportunities as well.
  
  
**Why Sandoz?**
Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, touched the lives of almost 500 million patients last year and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, state-of-the-art production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum and entrepreneurial spirit is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is encouraged!
  
  
The future is ours to shape!
  
  
#Sandoz

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Jubilant Bhartia Group**
Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. Jubilant Bhartia Group has four flagships Companies- Jubilant Pharmova Limited, Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, Jubilant FoodWorks Limited and Jubilant Industries Limited. Currently the group has a global workforce of around 43,000 employees.
  
  
**About Jubilant Ingrevia Limited**
***JubilantIngreviaisnowamemberoftheeliteGlobalLighthouseNetwork(GLN) oftheWorldEconomicForum(WEF)***
Jubilant Ingrevia history goes back to 1978 with the incorporation of VAM Organics Limited, which later became Jubilant Organosys and then Jubilant Life Sciences and now demerged to an independent entity as Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, which is listed in both the stock exchanges of India. Over the years, company has developed global capacities and leadership in chosen business segments.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Process & Chemical Engineer to lead the development, assessment, and scale-up of advanced treatment solutions for complex water, wastewater, and industrial effluents. The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).
* Publications: Minimum 3–5 publications in peer-reviewed journals; patents or book chapters preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional R&D teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Location**
Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

**Job Title: Principal Investigator – Process Engineer**
**Position Summary**
The Process Development group at Innovation Center in Hyderabad works as part of an interdisciplinary team to design and develop synthetic routes for commercial manufacturing processes. Principal Investigator – Process Engineer will provide engineering support of all phases of process development, with responsibility from early stage to commercial launch.  This role includes conducting laboratory-based programs to develop commercial manufacturing processes as part of a cross-functional team of process chemists, analytical chemists and engineers, also partnering with third party Contract Research Organizations (CRO) to ensure pilot campaign success and extract engineering learnings to be used in future commercial manufacturing designs.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**The Role (daily Responsibilities)**

* Lead chemical engineering deliverables for assigned synthetic programs from early and/or late-stage development through process characterization, technology transfer, piloting, validation, and commercial manufacturing.
* Develop and oversee process engineering deliverables, including Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), process descriptions, and detailed mass and heat balance calculations.
* Participate in rigorous risk assessments, HAZOP studies, failure-mode evaluations, and ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards.
* Provides subject matter expertise across development and scale-up, supporting technical package preparation, process and equipment fit assessment, scale-up strategies, facility readiness evaluations, technology transfer execution, validation activities, and post-transfer process stabilization.
* Provide strong technical leadership at CDMOs and manufacturing sites, including hands-on floor support, rapid troubleshooting, risk-based decision-making, issue escalation, and execution support during engineering, demonstration, pilot, and commercial campaigns.
* Build and maintain high-trust, high-accountability partnerships with external manufacturing partners by establishing clear governance, decision-making frameworks, communication pathways, performance expectations, and risk management processes.
* Lead or guide investigations, root-cause assessments, deviations, non-conformances, CAPAs, change controls, and process performance reviews using data-driven and science-based recommendations.
* Apply chemical engineering fundamentals, modeling, and manufacturing data to improve process capability, yield, purity, cycle time, safety, sustainability, productivity, and cost of goods.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and process simulation software (e.g., Aspen, MATLAB, Minitab, AutoCAD).
* Apply reaction engineering, thermodynamics, kinetics, heat and mass transfer, mixing, hydrodynamics, separations, filtration, drying, solid-liquid handling, and equipment design to development and manufacturing challenges.
* Create fit-for-purpose laboratory and engineering experiments, representative scale-down models, and process characterization studies that define mechanisms, operating ranges, robustness, and scale-up criteria.
* Integrate process safety, equipment and facility fit, material compatibility, containment, operability, maintainability, and human-factor considerations into process and technology-transfer decisions.
* Author, review, and defend engineering reports, technology-transfer packages, risk assessments, control strategy documents, technical investigations, and regulatory filing sections.
* Establish trusted relationships with CDMO leaders and technical teams while maintaining clear accountability, protecting FMC requirements, and addressing conflict or performance gaps directly and professionally.
* Distill complex technical information into concise recommendations, decision points, risks, and trade-offs for senior leaders, governance forums, regulatory stakeholders, and external partners.

**The Candidate (requirements)**

* Bachelor's or master's degree or Ph.D in Chemical Engineering is required.
* Chemical engineers with a strong foundation in chemical engineering and organic chemistry, combined with hands-on experience in process development, pilot plant operations, and commercial-scale manufacturing.
* 7-15 years in R&D process development in agrochemicals, pharmaceutical, fine or specialty chemicals industry required.
* Familiarity with concepts of developing safe and cost-effective chemical processes.
* Strong organic chemistry knowledge is a plus.
* Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively and work in teams of scientists.
* The ability to effectively develop and test hypotheses and quickly determine the feasibility of a proposal is critical.
* Willingness to work flexibly across multiple time zones and travel as required, including primarily domestic travel and occasional international travel.
* Flexible work schedules to accommodate work performed in different geographies required.
* Experience working in kilo, pilot and/or manufacturing scale environments is desirable.
