**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager - Product Development - Antenna to provide technical and product leadership for the development, integration, qualification, industrialization, and delivery of advanced Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA) antenna systems for SATCOM applications.
  
  
The candidate will act as a technical authority for phased-array antenna products, leading multidisciplinary engineering activities across the complete product lifecycle, from requirements definition and architecture through design reviews, qualification, production readiness, and final product delivery
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership, direction, and mentoring to multidisciplinary engineering teams involved in AESA antenna development, integration, verification, and qualification.
* Act as the Product Design Authority for phased-array antenna requirements, system architecture, key design decisions, technical trade-offs, and engineering review gates.
* Own and maintain the antenna product technical requirements baseline and ensure traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Lead technical activities through entire product lifecycle.
* Coordinate RF, antenna, electronics, mechanical, thermal, embedded software, FPGA, modem, systems engineering, manufacturing, and test teams.
* Follow up with suppliers, technology partners, and subcontractors to track technical activities, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and program milestones.
* Conduct and participate in technical design reviews with suppliers and internal engineering teams.
* Serve as the primary technical/program interface for major antenna development initiatives.
* Provide regular technical and program updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders, including progress, risks, dependencies, mitigation actions, and recovery plans.
* Foster effective collaboration across geographically distributed engineering teams and technology partners.
* Drive continuous improvement, design maturity, engineering best practices, and lessons learned throughout the product lifecycle.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, RF/Microwave, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant engineering experience, including at least 5 years in technical, engineering, or product leadership.
* Proven experience developing phased-array/AESA antennas and SATCOM products, preferably in Ka-band and/or Ku-band.
* Strong understanding of phased-array architectures, RF front ends, beamforming, antenna elements, calibration, and RF system design.
* Good knowledge of key antenna performance parameters, including EIRP, G/T, gain, polarization, scan loss, sidelobes, beamwidth, and cross-polarization.
* Good understanding of RF/microwave components, including PA, LNA, phase shifters, filters, MMICs, and beamforming ICs.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the complete development lifecycle, including SRR, PDR, CDR, qualification, acceptance, and product release.
* Experience with antenna integration, OTA/RF testing, anechoic chambers, and RF test equipment.
* Familiarity with antenna and RF simulation tools such as HFSS, CST, ADS, AWR, MATLAB, or equivalent.
* Experience with environmental qualification process as applicable.
* Experience working with suppliers and technology partners, including technical evaluations, RFI/RFP/RFQ reviews, compliance assessments, and technical negotiations.
* Ability to translate complex technical requirements and dependencies into clear and executable product development plans.
* Strong technical leadership, engineering judgment, system-level problem solving, and risk management skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional and geographically distributed teams in demanding development, integration, and qualification environments.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including customer, partner, and executive-level interactions.
* Strong focus on product quality, design maturity, manufacturability, continuous improvement, and technology evolution.

jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Sous Chef - International Cuisine
jobs.description:
Kitopi is the region's leading creator and partner for magical food experiences. With a purpose to satisfy the world’s appetite to create joy, Kitopi operates a portfolio of both invested and franchised F&B brands, serving as enablers in the industry by helping brands grow and scale in both the delivery and dine-in spaces.

Launched in Dubai, UAE, in January 2018, Kitopi has grown to become one of the greatest success stories in the food tech space. Kitopi’s kitchens are powered by its proprietary Smart Kitchen Operating System (SKOS) - an in-house suite of applications that optimizes cloud kitchen operations in real time.

With over 6,000 employees, Kitopi currently operates 200+ locations across the UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sous chef with a passion for international flavors to lead our culinary team. The ideal candidate will bring creativity, leadership, and a deep understanding of global cuisines to craft exceptional dining experiences that delight a diverse clientele.

**What You'll Do:**

* Develop and execute diverse menus featuring dishes from global cuisines (e.g., Mediterranean, Asian, Latin American, Middle Eastern, European).
* Lead and manage all kitchen operations, ensuring high standards of food quality, presentation, and hygiene.
* Train, mentor, and supervise kitchen staff, fostering a culture of excellence and collaboration.
* Oversee inventory management, food cost control, and supplier relationships.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations.
* Innovate seasonal and special event menus to reflect current culinary trends and customer preferences.
* Collaborate with front-of-house staff to ensure seamless service and guest satisfaction.

**What Are We Looking For:**

* Proven experience as a Sous Chef in a multicultural or international kitchen.
* Culinary degree or equivalent professional training.
* Deep knowledge of various international cuisines and cooking techniques.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency in kitchen budgeting, inventory, and cost control.

**Benefits**

* Extensive learning opportunities with hard and soft skill training to help you improve and challenge yourself.
* Be involved in customized trainings.
* Have the chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment.
* Become part of one of the most caring communities out there.
* The famous team activities and social events bursting with fun.
* Annual leave as per the company policy.
* Medical Insurance covering all necessary services.
* Yearly get-together for our Frontliner Champions.

**Recruitment Process and Timeline**

* **Application Review**
  : Submit your application, and our talent attraction team will review your profile.
* **Pre-Screening**
  : If your profile matches our requirements, you will receive a call from our talent team to discuss about the opportunity.
* **Interview Process**
  : If shortlisted, you will meet with our hiring/ operations managers and may need to attend one more round, which could include a trial at our kitchen or dine-in location.
* **Offer Discussion**
  : Upon successful completion of the interview & trial rounds, our recruiter will contact you to discuss the offer, post which, an offer letter will be released via email.

**So, what does it really mean to work at Kitopi?**

We are constantly striving to make Kitopi the best place to work, by empowering you to be the best version of yourself every day. Our company values act as our guiding principles to help ensure that everyone feels safe, included, and like they truly belong.

Kitopi is an equal-opportunity employer. While we currently operate in multiple countries, we are over 70 different nationalities of talented Kitopians. Whether you are a seasoned professional, a recent graduate, or someone looking to return to the workforce after a break, we encourage you to apply. We celebrate rich diverse backgrounds, lifestyles, and cultures and have a 0-tolerance policy towards racism, bigotry, and hate. Please apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat and help us build a company that we are all proud to work for.

Customer-obsessed and tech-enabled, at Kitopi, we are a team of passionate humans who are on a mission together to satisfy the world’s appetite and create joy.

jobs.title: Manager Engineering
jobs.description:
**About Us**
talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50+ countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About this role:**
We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real-time tracking and payments.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
  
  
We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this way.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat

**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days**
: You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
  
  
**By 6 months**
: Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
  
  
**By 12 months**
: You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**You must have**

* 6+ years of hands-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross-platform)
* 2+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade-offs between native vs cross-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data

**Bonus If You Have**

* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) or event-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams

**This role is for you if...**

* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought

**This role is NOT for you if...**

* You want a pure people-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices

**Additional Information**
**Your career growth path:**
Talabat Operates a Structured Career Framework With Clearly Defined Levels For Engineering Leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, You'll Enter An Established Progression That Rewards Growing Impact, Strategic Ownership, And People Leadership
  
  
**Engineering Manager**
— You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Manager**
— You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
  
  
**Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company-wide technical strategy, build director-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.

jobs.title: Manager Culinary Development
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**
Join our Catering team, where you will be part of an exciting business area that plays a vital role in delivering the Emirates ‘Fly Better’ experience. This team is responsible for a wide range of food and non-food functions, including catering, equipment, and amenities for inflight dining and special events.
  
  
If you are passionate about culinary excellence, logistics, and delivering world-class service, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As a key part of our Service Delivery operations, our catering team makes crucial decisions that enhance the customer experience and elevate our growing global brand.
  
  
As a
**Manager Culinary Development,**
you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.
  
  
Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be**

* Accountable for the planning and day to day management of the EK Culinary Centre of Excellence ensuring that annual targets of blue-sky cuisine innovations and individual dish creations are exceeded.
* In collaboration with the Service design team, responsible for supporting the decision making for flight/cabin level meal service standards.
* Accountable for the creation and development of detailed recipes that are conducive to performing optimally in the EK, network wide catering partner facilities.
* Responsible for documenting and version controlling all EK recipes and production methods in the EK owned, catering management system.
* In collaboration with the Regional Catering Management and Business Insights teams, accountable for station level menu planning ensuring customers’ expectations are exceeded.
* Accountable for planning and executing regular Dubai based, global inflight supplier culinary workshops to ensure that the education of individual dish and menu creations are understood and consistently translated around the EK network.

jobs.title: Data Science Manager - Applied AI
jobs.description:
Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
  
  
We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
  
  
Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.
  
  
****Job Description****
**About the Applied AI Tribe**
The Applied AI Tribe is talabat's internal AI engine, a team obsessed with turning cutting-edge AI into genuine, measurable business value. We don't build AI for its own sake. Our north star is Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**We have shipped 40+ AI products across four strategic streams:**

* Product & Tech Platform - AI capabilities embedded into talabat's core product and engineering platform.
* Business Automations - streamlined workflows that save real time and money across operations.
* Self-Serve AI Tools - empowering talabatis to build and use AI without needing to raise a ticket.
* Training & Onboarding - upskilling the tribe so every team can participate in the AI era.

Our engineering approach is built around shipping agentic AI systems at scale, with a harness-first philosophy, evaluation embedded into every product iteration, and production feedback loops that drive the roadmap.
  
  
**The Role**
As Manager, Data Scientist - AI within the Applied AI Tribe, you will lead a team of data scientists building and shipping the ML and generative AI systems that power decisions across talabat's product and business. You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****
**What Did We Order?**
****Technical Experience****

* Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, and data mining.
* Hands-on knowledge of ML and GenAI frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and LLM fine-tuning.
* Proficiency with the OpenAI SDK and familiarity with major LLM provider APIs for building and orchestrating production AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph for building stateful, multi-step agentic workflows and complex agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with Hugging Face (Transformers, Hub, Inference API) for model sourcing, fine-tuning, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of embeddings, dense and sparse retrieval, vector databases, and semantic search, for building RAG pipelines and similarity-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean production code, data structures and algorithms, ML system design.
* Proven experience shipping and monitoring ML models in production, with a solid grasp of MLOps practices.
* Strong data and ML engineering skills: building and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow) and robust feature engineering.
* Excellent SQL and Python; solid statistical foundations including experiment design, causal inference, and predictive methods.
* Familiarity with agentic system design (harness-first thinking, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and production feedback loops) is a strong plus.
* Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A postgraduate degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, and/or generative AI, including shipping models to production.
* 2+ years managing or leading a data science or ML team, with a track record of developing talent and delivering through others.
* Experience building ML systems in an online consumer product environment is a strong plus.

****Additional Information****
Mindset & Ways of Working
  
  

* Curiosity over certainty: you're excited to try the new model or framework this week.
* Ownership: you treat cost, latency, and business impact as your problem, and your team's.
* Bias to build: a prototype in a real workflow beats a perfect design doc every time.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: most of what we build has no playbook yet, and you help write it.
* Keep it simple: pick the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity, and #makeithappen.

**At talabat, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters, and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.**

jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.

* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.

* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.

* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.

jobs.title: Projects & Financial Planning Analyst ( Development Projects)
jobs.company: Mohammad Omar Bin Haider Group (MOBH Group)
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Projects & Financial Planning Analyst will be responsible for preparing economic and financial feasibility studies for new and existing projects, monitoring project progress and performance, and preparing accurate and well-structured financial and management reports for senior management.

The position requires strong analytical, financial, reporting, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate and prepare professional reports in both Arabic and English.

The Projects & Financial Planning Analyst will be responsible for preparing economic and financial feasibility studies for new and existing real estate development projects, monitoring project progress and performance, and preparing accurate and well-structured financial and management reports for senior management. The role will cover the various stages of the project lifecycle, from the design and planning stage through construction, completion, and handover, including monitoring project timelines, costs, budgets, and overall performance.

The position requires strong analytical, financial, reporting, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate and prepare professional reports in both Arabic and English.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Feasibility Studies & Financial Analysis**

• Prepare comprehensive economic and financial feasibility studies for proposed projects.

• Develop project financial models, budgets, cash flow projections, revenue and cost analyses.

• Assess project profitability, financial viability, risks, and potential returns.

• Prepare financial assumptions and scenarios to support management decision-making.

• Conduct sensitivity and scenario analysis where required.

**Project Monitoring & Follow-up**

• Monitor the progress of projects against approved plans, budgets, timelines, and key milestones.

• Coordinate with relevant departments, consultants, contractors, and project teams to obtain updated information.

• Identify delays, cost variations, risks, and other issues affecting project performance.

• Follow up on outstanding actions and provide management with regular updates.

• Financial & Management Reporting

• Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad-hoc project reports.

• Prepare financial performance reports, including budget versus actual analysis, project costs, revenues, cash flow, and variances.

• Consolidate project information into clear management reports.

• Highlight key issues, risks, financial implications, and required management actions.

**Reporting & Presentations**

• Prepare professional reports and presentations using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other relevant tools.

• Develop dashboards, financial summaries, charts, graphs, and management presentations.

• Present complex financial and project information in a clear and understandable format.

• Ensure all reports are accurate, consistent, professional, and properly structured.

**Bilingual Reporting**

• Prepare and present reports and management information in both Arabic and English.

• Translate and adapt financial and project-related information between Arabic and English while maintaining professional terminology and accuracy.

**Management Support**

• Provide management with timely analysis and information required for strategic and operational decisions.

• Support management in evaluating new investment and development opportunities.

• Prepare ad-hoc analysis, financial studies, presentations, and reports as requested by management.

**Key Competencies:**

* Financial Analysis & Modelling
* Feasibility Studies
* Project Monitoring & Controls
* Management Reporting
* Budgeting & Forecasting
* Data Analysis
* Business Presentation
* Attention to Detail
* Communication & Coordination
* Strategic Thinking
* Arabic & English Reporting

**Skills**

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience in project analysis, financial planning, feasibility studies, project controls, or management reporting.

• Strong knowledge of financial analysis and financial modelling.

• Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including financial models, formulas, Pivot Tables, charts, and data analysis.

• Strong PowerPoint and Word presentation and report-writing skills.

• Ability to prepare professional management dashboards and presentations.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong project follow-up and coordination skills.

• Excellent written and spoken Arabic and English.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet reporting deadlines.

• Experience in real estate, construction, development, investment, or other project-based businesses would be an advantage.

jobs.description:
**Overview Of The Role:**

The role is crucial in accurately recording, monitoring, and reporting financial transactions and activities associated with these departments. Reporting to the Finance Business Partner, the Accountant ensures compliance with financial processes and policies. Success is measured by the efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness of financial reporting, cash management, and the overall integrity of account management. The position also involves supporting various teams, ensuring the sound management of accounts receivable, and contributing to operational and financial objectives.

**What You Will Do:**

Invoicing & Delivery Management

* Perform financial transactions and process invoices in a timely manner.
* Ensure all AFM document processes are strictly adhered to, ensuring all bank payments are met.
* Ensure revenue/provision processes are accurate and the assignee clause is error-free.
* Substantiate financial transactions by auditing documents.
* Record and maintain all financial operations.
* Manage intra-company and government sales transactions.
* Authorize all in-house AFM sales and credit customers.
* Produce daily invoice summaries for credit invoices and sales return cases; monitor all outstanding debts and report accordingly.
* Support and guide Matrix Managers, Sales team, and Sales Admin.

Cash (Revenue & Petty Cash Fund) Management

* Collect and verify all cash/credit card/cheque payments against invoices and post collections in SAP.
* Monitor petty cash float to ensure adequate balance and review pending reimbursements/claims for submission.
* Maintain and balance daily collection and petty cash fund twice daily.
* Monitor insurance limits of cash/collection in vault and ensure coverage from AOIC if limits are exceeded.
* Deposit all collected revenue in SCDM on the same day.
* Upload daily collection reports to the shared drive provided by the FSSC/AFSS.
* Ensure all collection/PCF verification and handovers are properly signed and filed for future reference.
* Monitor and communicate cheque clearance, bouncing cheques, and refund cheques.
* Ensure accurate data entry in SAP, keep billing cancellations and advance payments minimal, and clear and monitor cash invoices not yet collected.
* Post sublet and bought-out charges to job cards for customer billing.
* Maintain strict adherence to AFM company policy regarding customer refunds and keep a log for tracking purposes.
* Perform surprise cash counts as per SOP.

Financial Reporting, Cost & Internal Controls

* Conduct finance-related processes in compliance with AFM policies and procedures (SOPs).
* Support monitoring of Opex and Capex.
* Ensure AFM administration document processes are adhered to at all times.
* Monitor clearance of open POs and follow up with COT and showroom admin team monthly.
* Carry out ad hoc tasks/reports as required by the FBP/FM/Branch Management.

Accounts Receivables Management (AR Management)

* Review and ensure timely submission of second sets.
* Daily/weekly/monthly monitoring of branch AR report and follow-up with channels for timely collection of outstanding/overdue invoices.
* Maintain a list of all credit facilities provided to branch credit customers, including credit limit, credit period, main contact details, and credit facility documents.
* Reconcile credit customer accounts.

**Skills**

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Proficiency in SAP and financial transaction processing.
* Ability to perform detailed audits and ensure compliance with financial procedures.
* Strong skills in cash management and reporting.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

* Bachelor's degree in accountancy or finance.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar role.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in financial software and systems (e.g., SAP) and financial analysis.

jobs.title: Senior Internal Auditor
jobs.description:
Job Purpose   

Perform assigned audit engagements, from start to finish, inclusive of preplanning and wrap up activities. Applies risk and control concepts to scenarios encountered and identifies any potential issues.   
Assist in the periodic Risk Assessments and development of the Risk-Based Work Plans and the periodic reporting to the Audit Committee and Senior Management on internal audit activities, performance, significant risk exposures, controls/governance issues and other related matters.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 1)   

**Professional Ethics**  
•    Participate in initiating/promoting the establishment and continuous improvement of the Corporate Governance Framework including Enterprise Risk Management, Corporate Code of Conduct, Ethics and Values.  
**Internal Audit Plan**  
•     Assist in the development of Annual Audit Plan (AAP) based on the results of risk assessment exercise.  
•     Provide input for the periodic reporting on audit activities and performance relative to its plans, significant risk exposures, control/governance issues and other related matters.  
**Audit Execution**  
•    Assist the auditors in the examination and analysis of records through executing audit program steps for the assigned audits.  
•    Develop process understanding of assigned business processes and determines business objectives, main functions, the nature of activities, potential risks and controls to be reviewed.Develop a detailed audit program / Risk & Control Matrix (RCM) for the assigned audit including the objectives, potential risk, key controls, audit procedures and the use of audit techniques and tools to evaluate governance, risks and controls processes, and submits audit program to for review and approval.  
•    Determine auditing procedures to be applied, including the use of Information Systems Audit Techniques, statistical sampling method or others.Ensure that adequate working papers and all relevant information are continuously documented and updated in the automated Audit Management System in accordance with pre-defined templates and audit procedures.  
•    Perform the audit in accordance with the approved audit program and ensures that audit objectives have been met to support the audit conclusions/results.  
•    Identify, obtain, analyse and appraise related systems and evidentiary data/information.  
•    Prepare working papers which record and summarize data on the assigned audit and the results of the audit examination.  
•    Appraise the adequacy of the corrective actions taken by management on audit recommendations through follow up audits and periodically reviews and updates the status of management action plans.   
•    Ensures that approved audit objectives have been met with adequate coverage of all relevant areas. Also ensures that sufficient appropriate audit evidence is obtained to support the conclusion and recommendations, and that the work has been performed in accordance with professional audit standards.  
•    Participate in conducting special reviews and undertakes administrative duties as directed by Head of Internal Audit.  
•    Perform (also supervises audits performed by Internal Auditors) in accordance with the approved RACM and professional standards on internal auditing.  
•    Ensures tasks assigned to junior staff are adequately performed and deliverables are in accordance with ADNOC Internal Audit procedures and quality standards.  
•    Identify high risk areas and key control points of the system to be reviewed.  
•    Evaluate the system’s effectiveness based on his / her business and audit experience and modifies, if necessary, the scope of the review, with the approval of Team Leader / Department Manager.  
•    Participate in special committees to provide independent and objective professional advice and consultancy services.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 2)   

**Audit Reports**  
•    Prepare audit report with conclusion, expressing professional opinions on the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management, control systems and the efficiency with which activities are carried out. Recommends improvement options to rectify reported deficiencies, for Team Leader / Department Manager’s review.  
•    Recommend practical improvements options corresponding to the observations with an objective to contribute to the improvement of governance, risks and control processes to assist in the achievement of the company business objectives.  
•    Follow- up on replies to issued draft and final audit reports and review the adequacy of the corrective actions taken on audit recommendations / improvement options.  
**Coordination**  
•    Assist Audit Management in arranging Audit Committee meetings, preparing the agenda, and minutes of meetings (MOMs) and reporting on Corporate Governance Framework, General Controls and other related issues as prescribed in the Audit Committee Charter.   
•    Conducts workshops or presentations to create awareness about IA function and demonstrate value addition across the ADNOC.  
•    Communicates identified issues with Internal Audit management to ensure potential high risk area of concerns are addressed in a timely and effective manner.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**  
•    Participate in the development and implementation of the automated Audit Management System.  
•    Provide professional advice on Group Companies’ Audit Committee Charter,   
**IA Charter and IA Methodology/Procedures. Provides assistance in the establishment of the Group Audit Committees/IA functions and related governance, when assigned.**  
•    Participate in initiating and coordinating the Group-wide specialized professional training programs.   
•    Conducts research and benchmarking to resolve audit issues, identify gaps and support IA function.

  
  
  
Job Specific Accountabilities (Part 3)   
  
Generic Accountabilities   

**Supervision**  
•    Plan, supervise and coordinate all activities in the assigned area to meet functional objectives.  
•    Train and develop the assigned staff on relevant skills to enable them to become proficient on the job and deliver the respective section objectives.  
**Budgets**  
•    Provide input for preparation of the Section / Department budgets and assist in the implementation of the approved Budget and work plans to deliver Section objectives.   
•    Investigate and highlight any significant variances to support effective performance and cost control  
**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures**  
•    Implement approved Section / Department policies, processes, systems, standards and procedures in order to support execution of the Section’s / Department work programs in line with Company and International standards.  
**Performance Management**  
•    Contribute to the achievement of the approved Performance Objectives for the Section / Department in line with the Company Performance framework.  
**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**  
•    Design and implement new tools and techniques to improve the quality and efficiency of operational processes.  
•    Identify improvements in internal processes against best practices in pursuit of greater efficiency in line with ISO standards in order to define intelligent solutions for issues confronting the function.  
**Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Sustainability**  
•    Comply with relevant HSE policies, procedures & controls and applicable legislation and sustainability guidelines in line with international standards, best practices and ADNOC Code of Practices.  
**Reports**  
•    Provide inputs to prepare Section MIS and progress reports for Company Management.

  
  
  
Generic Accountabilities (continue)   
  
Internal Communications & Working Relationships   

•    Regular Contacts with operational level management within all auditable departments throughout ADNOC.

**What Did We Order**

* Execute high-volume payment and supplier statement reconciliations across accounts payable, resolving discrepancies to maintain on-time payment schedules.

* Reconcile purchases, supplier invoices and bank payments, and investigate discrepancies.

jobs.title: 2027 Financial Analyst Intern

Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.  
Are you willing to dive deep to develop those solutions and deliver results? At Amazon, we move with purpose and speed, and this requires us to work with a dynamic network of retail, HR, marketing, tech and operations partners. We employ every facet of data and communication to ensure our partners and our leaders have the most up to date and reliable information to help them make the best possible decision.

We are looking for finance Interns to work alongside, and support managers gaining a deep insight into the financial systems, processes, and controls used to record Amazon’s growing volume of daily, weekly, and monthly transactions.  
You will learn how Finance supports the various business teams in forecasting and analyzing actual financial results, managing the external reporting of Amazon’s quarterly financial statements and inputting to the launch of new customer-focused initiatives to ensure customers can find and discover anything and everything they want online.  
Available to commence an internship in Q2 2027. You should be available for 3 to 6 months, full time (40h/week).

No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

jobs.title: Audit Supervisor
jobs.description:
**The candidate should be available in UAE - Do not apply if you are not available in UAE for****Immediate Joining**  
  
  
 The Audit Supervisor will be responsible for the planning, execution, supervision and completion of audit engagements for a diverse portfolio of UAE clients.

  
  

The successful candidate should have strong practical knowledge of International Standards on Auditing (ISAs), IFRS and UAE regulatory requirements, combined with the ability to manage multiple engagements, supervise junior team members and communicate effectively with clients and senior management.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

  
* Plan, execute and supervise statutory and other audit engagements from commencement through completion.
  
* Develop audit plans and determine appropriate audit procedures based on engagement risks and materiality.
  
* Perform and review risk assessments, audit working papers, substantive procedures and supporting documentation.
  
* Evaluate internal controls, accounting processes and financial reporting systems and identify control deficiencies.
  
* Review financial statements and disclosures for compliance with IFRS and applicable UAE requirements.
  
* Ensure audit engagements are conducted in accordance with International Standards on Auditing (ISAs) and the firm’s audit methodology.

* Identify significant accounting, audit and financial reporting matters and escalate them appropriately.
  
* Prepare and review management letters, audit findings and recommendations.
  
* Liaise directly with clients’ finance teams, management and other stakeholders throughout the engagement.
  
* Assist in resolving complex accounting and audit issues in consultation with senior management/partners.
  
* Maintain complete, accurate and properly documented audit files suitable for internal and external quality reviews.
  
* Support the firm’s ongoing development of audit methodologies, templates, quality management procedures and technical resources.
  
* Assist with proposals, client onboarding and other business development activities where required.
  

  

**Candidate Requirements**

  
  

Qualification

  
  

ACCA Affiliate, ACCA Member or equivalent internationally recognised professional accounting qualification.

  
  

Experience

  
  

  
* Approximately 4–6 years of external audit experience within a professional audit firm.
  
* At least 1–2 years of experience supervising audit engagements.
  
* UAE audit experience will be a strong advantage.
  
* Experience managing audits of SMEs and owner-managed businesses is desirable.
  

  

Technical Skills

  
  

  
* Strong working knowledge of IFRS.
  
* Strong understanding and practical application of International Standards on Auditing (ISAs).
  
* Ability to independently plan and execute audit engagements.
  
* Good understanding of audit risk assessment, materiality, sampling and substantive audit procedures.
  
* Strong financial statement preparation and review skills.
  
* Familiarity with UAE Corporate Tax and VAT.
  
* Experience with audit software and cloud-based accounting platforms.
  
* Strong Microsoft Excel and general IT skills.
  

  

*What We Are Looking For*

  
  

We are particularly interested in someone who is:

  
  

  
* Technically strong and detail-oriented.
  
* Capable of taking ownership of an audit engagement.
  
* Comfortable managing multiple assignments and deadlines.
  
* Confident in communicating directly with clients.
  
* Able to lead, coach and develop junior team members.
  
* Commercially aware while maintaining professional independence and audit quality.
  
* Proactive, organised and solution-oriented.
  
* Committed to professional ethics, integrity and confidentiality.

1. Ensure sales channels follow controlled work streams with due compliance and standards.

  

2. Conduct monitoring of agencies involved in the sales activity – in terms of performance, practices and effectiveness.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst - FP&A and Corporate Finance | Al-Futtaim Automotive | Dubai

Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. **Overview of the Role**

  

We are currently hiring a **Senior Financial Analyst – FP&A & Corporate Finance** to join a dynamic and fast-paced business environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded finance professional who thrives on transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive business performance. The role will play a key part in business planning, financial forecasting, performance analysis, investment evaluation, and strategic decision-making across multiple business streams.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead the annual budgeting process, quarterly forecasts, and long-term strategic planning.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models to support business decision-making.

* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to challenge assumptions, improve performance, and drive business growth.

* Strong expertise in FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.

* Proven capability in variance, profitability, margin, and cost analysis.
* Experience with investment appraisal and business case development.
* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate data into commercial insights.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP, planning, and BI platforms.

You will be joining a high-performing finance team that partners closely with business leaders to drive financial performance and strategic growth. Job Purpose   

Perform assigned audit engagements, from start to finish, inclusive of preplanning and wrap up activities. Applies risk and control concepts to scenarios encountered and identifies any potential issues.   
Assist in the periodic Risk Assessments and development of the Risk-Based Work Plans and the periodic reporting to the Audit Committee and Senior Management on internal audit activities, performance, significant risk exposures, controls/governance issues and other related matters.

**Professional Ethics**  
•    Participate in initiating/promoting the establishment and continuous improvement of the Corporate Governance Framework including Enterprise Risk Management, Corporate Code of Conduct, Ethics and Values.  
**Internal Audit Plan**  
•     Assist in the development of Annual Audit Plan (AAP) based on the results of risk assessment exercise.  
•     Provide input for the periodic reporting on audit activities and performance relative to its plans, significant risk exposures, control/governance issues and other related matters.

•    Assist the auditors in the examination and analysis of records through executing audit program steps for the assigned audits.

•    Determine auditing procedures to be applied, including the use of Information Systems Audit Techniques, statistical sampling method or others.Ensure that adequate working papers and all relevant information are continuously documented and updated in the automated Audit Management System in accordance with pre-defined templates and audit procedures.  
•    Perform the audit in accordance with the approved audit program and ensures that audit objectives have been met to support the audit conclusions/results.  
•    Identify, obtain, analyse and appraise related systems and evidentiary data/information.  
•    Prepare working papers which record and summarize data on the assigned audit and the results of the audit examination.  
•    Appraise the adequacy of the corrective actions taken by management on audit recommendations through follow up audits and periodically reviews and updates the status of management action plans.   
•    Ensures that approved audit objectives have been met with adequate coverage of all relevant areas. Also ensures that sufficient appropriate audit evidence is obtained to support the conclusion and recommendations, and that the work has been performed in accordance with professional audit standards.

•    Participate in special committees to provide independent and objective professional advice and consultancy services.

Recommends improvement options to rectify reported deficiencies, for Team Leader / Department Manager’s review.

**Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Sustainability**

**Reports**

At Tirlán, we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We value diversity of thought, experience and background, recognising that inclusion fuels innovation and drives better outcomes for our customers, communities and colleagues.

jobs.title: Scientific Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.
  
  
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**
**Role Summary**
**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**
The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.
  
  
This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.
  
  
The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.
  
  
**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**
This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.
  
  
Role duties and accountabilities
  
  

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

**Experience, Skills, Knowledge**
Experience Required
  
  

* 5-10 years of experience in relevant scientific field
* Proven expertise engaging with and mobilising scientific KOLs / PHAs and interest groups
* Knowledge and experience of BAT's New Category products, ingredients, and technologies
* Familiarity with BAT’s 9-step scientific risk assessment framework and Tobacco Harm Reduction principles
* Sound knowledge of tobacco, food, or pharmaceutical science complexities including chemistry, toxicology, pre-clinical, clinical, and behavioural science
* Understanding of the regulatory environment in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, especially concerning tobacco, food, medicinal, and pharmaceutical sectors
* Proven experience interacting with regulatory authorities in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus, managing pharmaceutical regulations, regulatory pathways, and scientific requirements, with the capacity to apply this knowledge to complex scientific and policy discussions
* Experience in managing complex market-facing and regulatory dependent projects
* Understands World Health Organization’s political environment and public policy-making processes
* Experience of crafting and managing 3rd party networks
* Experience in regulatory rulemaking processes
* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Outstanding communication abilities

**Technical / Functional / Leadership Skills Required**

* Proven ability to engage external and internal collaborators in an empathetic manner
* Skills in managing projects
* Strong communication capabilities

**Education / Professional Qualifications / Certifications Required**

* Educated to a post-graduate degree (PhD or equivalent experience, MD, or Pharmacist)
* Excellent written and spoken English

Beneficial
  
  

* Appreciation of challenges of working in a complex matrix environment and proven experience of delivering results
* Active interest in controversial regulatory control issues and skills for absorbing and applying knowledge to the debate

**What we offer you?**

* We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
* Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
* Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter
